#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# Nxeon — verify a compute node is configured EXACTLY like a correct one
# =============================================================================
# READ-ONLY and idempotent. Changes nothing on the node (no files written, no
# services touched). Prints one PASS/WARN/FAIL line per check, and for every
# FAIL/WARN the exact remediation command. Exit status:
#     0  no FAIL            (WARNs allowed unless --strict)
#     1  at least one FAIL  (or WARN with --strict)
#     2  usage / could not reach the node
#
# Run it from the PRIMARY (it SSHes to the node with the same key the primary
# already uses), or ON the node itself with `local`:
#
#     scripts/verify-node.sh node-5            # by Node.name (looked up in the DB)
#     scripts/verify-node.sh 54.39.132.159     # by public IP
#     scripts/verify-node.sh --all             # every row of the Node table + a matrix
#     scripts/verify-node.sh local             # this host (compute-node profile)
#     scripts/verify-node.sh --primary local   # this host, primary profile
#
# onboard-node.sh calls this itself as its last step (`local`), and the runbook
# in docs/DOCUMENTATION.md ("Adding node N") makes a clean run the gate for
# flipping Node.enabled.
#
# What it checks (ids are stable; grep them in the docs):
#   host.*     PVE services, hostname, repos, time sync, unattended-upgrades, SMART,
#              journald cap, root-disk headroom, ZFS pool health, ARC cap, sysctl
#   net.*      vmbr1 address + persistence, MASQUERADE live+persisted, NAT chain,
#              nft forward policy
#   fw.*       nxeon_fw table, admin/agent allowlists contain the primary, persistence
#              files, ruleset == repo, fail2ban (+ primary in ignoreip)
#   agent.*    node-agent service/port/env/cert/token auth, Node.js, file drift
#   st.*       storages (vmdata, vmdata-hdd, backup alias), backup volume NOT on
#              the root fs, vendor snippet present + byte-identical
#   tpl.*      templates 9000-9009 present, template=1, agent on, disk present,
#              cicustom storage resolves, config identical to the primary's
#   api.*      role has every canonical privilege, ACL, token (privsep 0),
#              EFFECTIVE permissions incl. VM.GuestAgent.FileRead + SDN.Use
#   bk.*       backup units (timer enabled AND running), scripts, fresh archives
#   db.*       the Node row matches reality (ip/pveNode/subnet/chain/storages/
#              capacity/cost/region/agent), no duplicates, every active OsTemplate
#              exists on the node, memory samples flowing, region touchpoints in code
#
# Options:
#   --all                 verify every Node row, then print a matrix
#   --primary             treat the target as the PRIMARY node (skips agent/firewall-allowlist checks)
#   --node-num N          expected node ordinal (default: derived from the DB / vmbr1 address)
#   --primary-ip IP       the primary's public IP (default: from the DB, else this host's)
#   --agent-port N        expected node-agent port (default: DB value, else 8943)
#   --api-token ID=SECRET also test the Proxmox API with this token (or env NXEON_VERIFY_API_TOKEN)
#   --ssh-user U          default root          --ssh-opts "..."   extra ssh options
#   --no-db               skip db.* checks (also automatic when no DB is reachable)
#   --quiet               print only WARN/FAIL lines
#   --strict              WARN also fails the exit status
#   -h, --help
# =============================================================================
set -u

SELF="$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-$0}" 2>/dev/null || echo "$0")"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(dirname "$SELF")"
REPO_DIR="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd)"
CANON="${SCRIPT_DIR}/node-canon.sh"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REMOTE PART: runs ON the node (shipped over ssh, or executed locally).
# Prints RESULT|STATUS|id|message|fix   and   FACT|key|value  lines only.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [[ -n "${NXEON_V_REMOTE:-}" ]]; then
  # canon is prepended to the shipped payload; when run locally we source it.
  if ! type nxeon_derive_net >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # shellcheck source=scripts/node-canon.sh
    source "$CANON" || { echo "RESULT|FAIL|verify.canon|cannot source node-canon.sh|"; exit 0; }
  fi

  PROFILE="${NXEON_V_PROFILE:-compute}"          # compute | primary
  EXP_PRIMARY_IP="${NXEON_V_PRIMARY_IP:-}"
  EXP_AGENT_PORT="${NXEON_V_AGENT_PORT:-8943}"
  EXP_NODE_NUM="${NXEON_V_NODE_NUM:-}"
  EXP_PRIMARY_KEY="${NXEON_V_PRIMARY_KEY:-}"
  EXP_FW_SHA="${NXEON_V_FW_SHA:-}"
  EXP_AGENT_SHA="${NXEON_V_AGENT_SHA:-}"
  EXP_AGENT_UNIT_SHA="${NXEON_V_AGENT_UNIT_SHA:-}"
  API_TOKEN="${NXEON_V_API_TOKEN:-}"
  FIXHINT="re-run on the node: scripts/onboard-node.sh --node-num <N> --primary-ip <PRIMARY_IP> (idempotent)"

  res()  { local m="${3//|//}" f="${4//|//}"; printf 'RESULT|%s|%s|%s|%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$m" "$f"; }
  pass() { res PASS "$1" "$2"; }
  warn() { res WARN "$1" "$2" "${3:-}"; }
  fail() { res FAIL "$1" "$2" "${3:-}"; }
  fact() { printf 'FACT|%s|%s\n' "$1" "${2//|//}"; }
  have() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
  sha12() { sha256sum "$1" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-12; }
  is_primary() { [[ "$PROFILE" == "primary" ]]; }

  STORAGE_CFG=/etc/pve/storage.cfg
  PVE_NODE="$(hostname)"
  fact hostname "$PVE_NODE"
  fact profile "$PROFILE"

  # ----- identity facts -------------------------------------------------------
  PUBLIC_IP="$(ip -4 -o addr show vmbr0 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1 | head -1)"
  [[ -z "$PUBLIC_IP" ]] && PUBLIC_IP="$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"
  fact public_ip "$PUBLIC_IP"
  MEM_MB="$(awk '/MemTotal/{print int($2/1024)}' /proc/meminfo)"
  fact mem_total_mb "$MEM_MB"
  fact pveversion "$(pveversion 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/ (running.*//')"
  VMBR1_ADDR="$(ip -4 -o addr show "${NXEON_V_BRIDGE:-vmbr1}" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | head -1)"
  fact vmbr1_addr "$VMBR1_ADDR"

  BRIDGE="${NXEON_V_BRIDGE:-vmbr1}"
  # Expected network derived from the node number (given) or from vmbr1's address.
  EXP_SUBNET_CIDR="" EXP_GATEWAY="" EXP_CHAIN=""
  if [[ -n "$EXP_NODE_NUM" ]]; then
    nxeon_derive_net "$EXP_NODE_NUM" 2>/dev/null && { EXP_SUBNET_CIDR="$D_SUBNET_CIDR"; EXP_GATEWAY="$D_GATEWAY"; EXP_CHAIN="$D_NAT_CHAIN"; }
  elif [[ -n "$VMBR1_ADDR" ]]; then
    oct="$(echo "$VMBR1_ADDR" | awk -F'[./]' '{print $3}')"
    if [[ "$oct" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
      nxeon_derive_net "$((oct + 1))" "$oct" && { EXP_SUBNET_CIDR="$D_SUBNET_CIDR"; EXP_GATEWAY="$D_GATEWAY"; EXP_CHAIN="$D_NAT_CHAIN"; }
    fi
  fi
  fact exp_subnet_cidr "$EXP_SUBNET_CIDR"
  fact exp_chain "$EXP_CHAIN"

  # ======================= host.* =============================================
  for u in pve-cluster pveproxy pvedaemon pvestatd; do
    if systemctl is-active --quiet "$u"; then :; else bad_svc="${bad_svc:-} $u"; fi
  done
  if [[ -z "${bad_svc:-}" ]]; then pass host.pve_services "pve-cluster/pveproxy/pvedaemon/pvestatd all active"
  else fail host.pve_services "inactive Proxmox services:${bad_svc}" "systemctl restart${bad_svc}; journalctl -u${bad_svc// / -u } -n 50"; fi

  hip="$(getent hosts "$PVE_NODE" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | head -1)"
  if [[ -n "$hip" && "$hip" != 127.* && "$hip" != "::1" ]]; then pass host.hostname "hostname ${PVE_NODE} resolves to ${hip}"
  else fail host.hostname "hostname ${PVE_NODE} resolves to '${hip:-nothing}' (Proxmox needs a non-loopback address)" "echo '${PUBLIC_IP} ${PVE_NODE}' >> /etc/hosts   # then: pvecm updatecerts --force && systemctl restart pveproxy"; fi

  ent=""
  for f in /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*; do
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    if grep -q 'enterprise.proxmox.com' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
      case "$f" in
        *.sources) grep -qiE '^Enabled:[[:space:]]*(no|false)' "$f" || ent="$ent $f" ;;
        *) grep -E '^[[:space:]]*deb' "$f" | grep -q enterprise.proxmox.com && ent="$ent $f" ;;
      esac
    fi
  done
  if grep -rqs 'pve-no-subscription' /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ && [[ -z "$ent" ]]; then
    pass host.repos "pve-no-subscription repo present, no enterprise repo enabled"
  elif [[ -n "$ent" ]]; then
    warn host.repos "enterprise repo enabled without a subscription (apt update will 401):$ent" "re-run onboard-node.sh (it disables enterprise repos + adds pve-no-subscription), or add 'Enabled: no' to$ent"
  else
    warn host.repos "pve-no-subscription repo not configured — no security/package updates" "re-run onboard-node.sh (adds /etc/apt/sources.list.d/proxmox-nxeon.sources)"
  fi

  if [[ "$(timedatectl show -p NTPSynchronized --value 2>/dev/null)" == "yes" ]]; then pass host.time "system clock NTP-synchronized"
  else fail host.time "clock NOT synchronized (TLS, cloud-init and Stripe webhooks all break with clock skew)" "apt-get install -y chrony && systemctl enable --now chrony   # then: chronyc tracking"; fi

  if dpkg -s unattended-upgrades >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl is-enabled --quiet unattended-upgrades 2>/dev/null \
     && grep -qs 'Unattended-Upgrade "1"' /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades; then
    pass host.unattended_upgrades "unattended-upgrades installed, enabled, configured"
  else
    warn host.unattended_upgrades "unattended-upgrades missing/disabled — security patches not applied automatically" "apt-get install -y unattended-upgrades && printf 'APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists \"1\";\nAPT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade \"1\";\n' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades && systemctl enable --now unattended-upgrades"
  fi

  if have smartctl && systemctl is-active --quiet smartmontools 2>/dev/null; then
    smart_bad=""
    for d in /dev/nvme?n1 /dev/sd?; do
      [[ -b "$d" ]] || continue
      out="$(smartctl -H "$d" 2>&1)"
      if echo "$out" | grep -qiE 'overall-health.*(PASSED)|SMART Health Status: OK'; then :
      elif echo "$out" | grep -qiE 'FAILED'; then smart_bad="$smart_bad $d"; fi   # unreadable (RAID/USB) is not a failure
    done
    if [[ -n "$smart_bad" ]]; then fail host.smart "SMART FAILED on:$smart_bad" "smartctl -a${smart_bad%% *}   # order a disk replacement from the provider NOW"
    else pass host.smart "smartmontools active, all readable disks PASSED"; fi
  else
    warn host.smart "smartmontools not installed/active — disk failure would be a surprise" "apt-get install -y smartmontools && systemctl enable --now smartmontools"
  fi

  if grep -rhsE '^[[:space:]]*SystemMaxUse=' /etc/systemd/journald.conf /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    pass host.journald_cap "journald size capped ($(grep -rhsE '^[[:space:]]*SystemMaxUse=' /etc/systemd/journald.conf /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/ | tail -1 | tr -d ' '))"
  else
    warn host.journald_cap "journald has no SystemMaxUse (grows until it eats the root fs)" "mkdir -p /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d && printf '[Journal]\nSystemMaxUse=${NXEON_CANON_JOURNAL_MAX}\n' > /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/nxeon.conf && systemctl restart systemd-journald"
  fi

  root_pct="$(df -P / | awk 'NR==2{gsub("%","",$5); print $5}')"
  fact root_pct "$root_pct"
  if (( root_pct >= 90 )); then fail host.root_disk "root filesystem ${root_pct}% full — Postgres/PVE/vzdump fail when it hits 100%" "du -xh --max-depth=2 / | sort -rh | head; move /tank/backup off the root fs (see st.hdd_not_root) / apt-get clean / journalctl --vacuum-size=200M"
  elif (( root_pct >= 80 )); then warn host.root_disk "root filesystem ${root_pct}% full" "du -xh --max-depth=2 / | sort -rh | head"
  else pass host.root_disk "root filesystem ${root_pct}% used"; fi

  if have zpool; then
    zbad="$(zpool list -H -o name,health 2>/dev/null | awk '$2!="ONLINE"{print $1"="$2}' | tr '\n' ' ')"
    if [[ -z "$zbad" ]]; then pass host.zpool_health "all ZFS pools ONLINE ($(zpool list -H -o name | tr '\n' ' '))"
    else fail host.zpool_health "pool(s) not ONLINE: $zbad" "zpool status -v"; fi
    # ARC cap: persisted + live + sane
    cap_conf="$(grep -hsE '^[[:space:]]*options[[:space:]]+zfs[[:space:]].*zfs_arc_max=' /etc/modprobe.d/*.conf 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | grep -oE 'zfs_arc_max=[0-9]+' | cut -d= -f2)"
    cap_live="$(cat /sys/module/zfs/parameters/zfs_arc_max 2>/dev/null)"
    fact arc_cap_bytes "${cap_live:-}"
    min_b=$((NXEON_CANON_ARC_MIN_GB * 1073741824)); max_b=$((NXEON_CANON_ARC_MAX_GB * 1073741824))
    arc_fix="echo 'options zfs zfs_arc_max=$((NXEON_CANON_ARC_GB_DEFAULT * 1073741824))' > /etc/modprobe.d/zfs-arc.conf && echo $((NXEON_CANON_ARC_GB_DEFAULT * 1073741824)) > /sys/module/zfs/parameters/zfs_arc_max   # (root-on-ZFS: also update-initramfs -u -k all)"
    if [[ -z "$cap_conf" ]]; then fail host.zfs_arc "no persisted zfs_arc_max — ZFS will cache up to ~50% of RAM and the admin RAM gauge reads CRITICAL with nothing running" "$arc_fix"
    elif [[ -z "$cap_live" || "$cap_live" == "0" ]]; then fail host.zfs_arc "zfs_arc_max persisted (${cap_conf}) but NOT live (live=${cap_live:-unset}) — reboot or set it now" "echo ${cap_conf} > /sys/module/zfs/parameters/zfs_arc_max"
    elif (( cap_live < min_b )); then warn host.zfs_arc "ARC cap is only $((cap_live / 1048576)) MB (<${NXEON_CANON_ARC_MIN_GB} GB) — ZFS reads will be slow" "$arc_fix"
    elif (( cap_live > max_b )); then warn host.zfs_arc "ARC cap $((cap_live / 1073741824)) GB (> ${NXEON_CANON_ARC_MAX_GB} GB) squeezes VM RAM" "$arc_fix"
    elif [[ "$cap_conf" != "$cap_live" ]]; then warn host.zfs_arc "persisted ARC cap ($cap_conf) differs from live ($cap_live)" "echo ${cap_conf} > /sys/module/zfs/parameters/zfs_arc_max"
    else pass host.zfs_arc "ZFS ARC capped at $((cap_live / 1073741824)) GB (persisted + live)"; fi
  fi

  fwd="$(sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward 2>/dev/null)"
  fwd_persist="$(grep -rhsE '^[[:space:]]*net\.ipv4\.ip_forward[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*1' /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/ 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
  if [[ "$fwd" == "1" && -n "$fwd_persist" ]]; then pass host.sysctl_forward "ip_forward=1 live and persisted"
  elif [[ "$fwd" == "1" ]]; then warn host.sysctl_forward "ip_forward=1 live but only set by the bridge post-up (lost on ifreload)" "nxeon: printf 'net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1\n' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon.conf && sysctl --system"
  else fail host.sysctl_forward "ip_forward is OFF — NAT'd customer VMs have no internet or inbound forwards" "sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 && printf 'net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1\n' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon.conf"; fi
  ct="$(sysctl -n net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max 2>/dev/null)"
  if [[ -z "$ct" ]]; then warn host.conntrack "nf_conntrack not loaded yet (loads with the first NAT rule)" ""
  elif (( ct >= NXEON_CANON_CONNTRACK_MIN )); then pass host.conntrack "nf_conntrack_max=${ct} (>= ${NXEON_CANON_CONNTRACK_MIN})"
  else warn host.conntrack "nf_conntrack_max=${ct} < ${NXEON_CANON_CONNTRACK_MIN} — game UDP flows can exhaust it" "echo 'net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = ${NXEON_CANON_CONNTRACK_MIN}' >> /etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon.conf && sysctl --system"; fi

  if [[ -n "$EXP_PRIMARY_KEY" && ! $(is_primary; echo $?) == 0 ]]; then
    if grep -qsF "$EXP_PRIMARY_KEY" /root/.ssh/authorized_keys; then pass host.ssh_primary_key "primary's SSH key is in authorized_keys"
    else warn host.ssh_primary_key "primary's SSH public key NOT in /root/.ssh/authorized_keys — primary-side ops (verify-node, template copy, migrations) cannot reach this node" "cat /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub  # on the primary, append to this node's /root/.ssh/authorized_keys"; fi
  fi
  pwauth="$(sshd -T 2>/dev/null | awk '$1=="passwordauthentication"{print $2}')"
  if [[ "$pwauth" == "no" ]]; then pass host.ssh_hardening "SSH password authentication disabled"
  else warn host.ssh_hardening "SSH PasswordAuthentication is ON (mitigated by the admin allowlist + fail2ban, but a leaked root password is full compromise)" "ensure your key works, then: printf 'PasswordAuthentication no\n' > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-nxeon-hardening.conf && sshd -t && systemctl reload ssh   # or run onboard-node.sh --harden-ssh"; fi

  newest_kernel="$(ls -v /boot/vmlinuz-* 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | sed 's#/boot/vmlinuz-##')"
  if [[ -n "$newest_kernel" && "$newest_kernel" != "$(uname -r)" ]]; then warn host.kernel "running kernel $(uname -r) but $newest_kernel is installed — schedule a reboot window (migrate/notify customers first)" "# plan a reboot; do NOT reboot a node with live customers without notice"
  else pass host.kernel "running the newest installed kernel ($(uname -r))"; fi
  fact swap "$(swapon --show=NAME,SIZE --noheadings 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ';')"
  fact ksm "run=$(cat /sys/kernel/mm/ksm/run 2>/dev/null)"

  # ======================= net.* ==============================================
  if [[ -z "$VMBR1_ADDR" ]]; then
    fail net.bridge "bridge ${BRIDGE} missing or has no IPv4 address" "$FIXHINT"
  elif [[ -n "$EXP_GATEWAY" && "$VMBR1_ADDR" != "${EXP_GATEWAY}/24" ]]; then
    fail net.bridge "${BRIDGE} has ${VMBR1_ADDR}, expected ${EXP_GATEWAY}/24" "fix /etc/network/interfaces (address ${EXP_GATEWAY}/24) then ifreload -a"
  else
    pass net.bridge "${BRIDGE} up with ${VMBR1_ADDR}"
  fi
  if grep -rqsE "^[[:space:]]*auto[[:space:]]+${BRIDGE}\b" /etc/network/interfaces /etc/network/interfaces.d/ 2>/dev/null; then pass net.bridge_persist "${BRIDGE} stanza persisted in /etc/network/interfaces"
  else fail net.bridge_persist "${BRIDGE} is not in /etc/network/interfaces — it vanishes on reboot, every customer VM loses its network" "$FIXHINT"; fi
  if [[ -n "$EXP_SUBNET_CIDR" ]]; then
    masq_live=0
    iptables -t nat -S POSTROUTING 2>/dev/null | grep -qE -- "-s ${EXP_SUBNET_CIDR//./\\.} .*MASQUERADE" && masq_live=1
    masq_conf=0
    grep -rqsE "iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s '?${EXP_SUBNET_CIDR//./\\.}'? .*MASQUERADE" /etc/network/interfaces /etc/network/interfaces.d/ 2>/dev/null && masq_conf=1
    if (( masq_live && masq_conf )); then pass net.masquerade "MASQUERADE for ${EXP_SUBNET_CIDR} live and persisted"
    elif (( masq_live )); then warn net.masquerade "MASQUERADE live but not persisted via bridge post-up (lost on reboot)" "$FIXHINT"
    else fail net.masquerade "no MASQUERADE rule for ${EXP_SUBNET_CIDR} — VMs have no outbound internet" "iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s ${EXP_SUBNET_CIDR} ! -d ${EXP_SUBNET_CIDR} -j MASQUERADE   # + persist: $FIXHINT"; fi
  fi
  if [[ -n "$EXP_CHAIN" ]]; then
    nvms="$(qm list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 && $1>=100 && $1<9000' | wc -l)"
    if iptables -t nat -S "$EXP_CHAIN" >/dev/null 2>&1 && iptables -t nat -S PREROUTING 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- "-j ${EXP_CHAIN}\$"; then
      pass net.nat_chain "${EXP_CHAIN} exists and is jumped from PREROUTING ($(iptables -t nat -S "$EXP_CHAIN" | grep -c DNAT) DNAT rules)"
    elif (( nvms > 0 )); then
      fail net.nat_chain "${EXP_CHAIN} missing but ${nvms} customer VM(s) exist — their SSH/game ports are unreachable until the worker re-syncs" "On the PRIMARY: trigger NAT sync (admin > Network > resync) or restart nxeon-worker in a maintenance window; the node-agent recreates the chain via /v1/nat/ensure-chain"
    else
      warn net.nat_chain "${EXP_CHAIN} not created yet (normal for an empty node: the worker/agent creates it on the first provision)" ""
    fi
  fi
  if nft list table inet nxeon_fw >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    fwdpol="$(nft list chain inet nxeon_fw forward 2>/dev/null)"
    if [[ -n "$fwdpol" ]] && echo "$fwdpol" | grep -q 'policy drop' && ! echo "$fwdpol" | grep -q "iifname \"${BRIDGE}\" accept"; then
      fail net.forward_policy "nxeon_fw forward chain drops by default and does not accept ${BRIDGE} traffic — VM NAT is broken" "$FIXHINT"
    else pass net.forward_policy "nft forward policy lets ${BRIDGE} traffic through"; fi
  fi

  # ======================= fw.* / agent.* (compute nodes) =====================
  if is_primary; then
    nft list table inet nxeon_fw >/dev/null 2>&1 && pass fw.table "primary: nxeon_fw table loaded" || fail fw.table "primary: nxeon_fw table NOT loaded" "/opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --check && systemctl start nxeon-firewall"
    systemctl is-active --quiet fail2ban && pass fw.fail2ban "fail2ban active" || fail fw.fail2ban "fail2ban inactive" "systemctl enable --now fail2ban"
  else
    if nft list table inet nxeon_fw >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      pass fw.table "nxeon_fw table loaded"
      inpol="$(nft list chain inet nxeon_fw input 2>/dev/null)"
      echo "$inpol" | grep -q 'policy drop' && pass fw.input_policy "input chain default policy is DROP" \
        || fail fw.input_policy "input chain is not default-drop" "$FIXHINT"
      if echo "$inpol" | grep -qE 'tcp dport \{ 22, 8006 \}.*drop'; then pass fw.admin_ports_gated "tcp 22 + 8006 are dropped for non-allowlisted sources"
      else fail fw.admin_ports_gated "no drop rule for tcp 22/8006 — SSH + Proxmox API are exposed to the internet" "/opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --check && /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --apply   # then --confirm from a 2nd terminal"; fi
      adm="$(nft list set inet nxeon_fw nxeon_admin_v4 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n\t')"
      agt="$(nft list set inet nxeon_fw nxeon_agent_allow_v4 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n\t')"
      if [[ -n "$EXP_PRIMARY_IP" ]]; then
        echo "$adm" | grep -qF "$EXP_PRIMARY_IP" && pass fw.admin_set "primary ${EXP_PRIMARY_IP} is in nxeon_admin_v4 (Proxmox API :8006 reachable by the platform)" \
          || fail fw.admin_set "primary ${EXP_PRIMARY_IP} NOT in nxeon_admin_v4 — the platform cannot reach this node's Proxmox API" "/opt/nxeon/scripts/admin-ip.sh add ${EXP_PRIMARY_IP}"
        if echo "$agt" | grep -qF "$EXP_PRIMARY_IP"; then
          extra="$(echo "$agt" | sed -n 's/.*elements = {\(.*\)}.*/\1/p' | tr ',' '\n' | tr -d ' ' | grep -v -x -F "$EXP_PRIMARY_IP" | grep . | tr '\n' ' ')"
          [[ -z "$extra" ]] && pass fw.agent_set "node-agent port reachable from the primary only" \
            || warn fw.agent_set "nxeon_agent_allow_v4 also contains: ${extra}(must be the primary only)" "edit /etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft and reload the firewall"
        else fail fw.agent_set "primary ${EXP_PRIMARY_IP} NOT in nxeon_agent_allow_v4 — NAT sync/snippet writes to this node fail" "echo 'add element inet nxeon_fw nxeon_agent_allow_v4 { ${EXP_PRIMARY_IP} }' | nft -f - && echo 'add element inet nxeon_fw nxeon_agent_allow_v4 { ${EXP_PRIMARY_IP} } # primary' > /etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft"; fi
      else warn fw.admin_set "primary IP unknown to the verifier; pass --primary-ip to check the allowlists" ""; fi
    else
      fail fw.table "nxeon_fw table NOT loaded — this node's SSH + Proxmox API are open to the whole internet" "/opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --check && /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --apply   # confirm from a second terminal, then --confirm"
    fi
    miss=""
    for f in /etc/nxeon/admin-ips.nft /etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft /etc/nxeon/firewall.nft.rollback /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh /opt/nxeon/scripts/admin-ip.sh; do [[ -s "$f" ]] || miss="$miss $f"; done
    if [[ -z "$miss" ]] && systemctl is-enabled --quiet nxeon-firewall.service 2>/dev/null; then pass fw.persistence "firewall files present, nxeon-firewall.service enabled (survives reboot)"
    else fail fw.persistence "missing:${miss} / nxeon-firewall.service not enabled — ruleset will not return after a reboot" "$FIXHINT"; fi
    if [[ -s /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft ]]; then
      nft -c -f /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft >/dev/null 2>&1 && pass fw.parse "ruleset file parses (nft -c)" || fail fw.parse "firewall.nft does NOT parse — the next reboot comes up unprotected" "nft -c -f /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft  # read the error; usually a wrong table name in /etc/nxeon/*.nft"
      grep -qE "define NXEON_AGENT_PORT = ${EXP_AGENT_PORT}\b" /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft && pass fw.agent_port "firewall agent port == ${EXP_AGENT_PORT}" \
        || fail fw.agent_port "firewall.nft agent port differs from the expected ${EXP_AGENT_PORT}" "sed -i 's/define NXEON_AGENT_PORT = .*/define NXEON_AGENT_PORT = ${EXP_AGENT_PORT}/' /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft && /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --apply"
      if [[ -n "$EXP_FW_SHA" ]]; then
        [[ "$(sha12 /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft)" == "$EXP_FW_SHA" ]] && pass fw.ruleset_drift "firewall.nft identical to the repo's firewall-node.nft" \
          || warn fw.ruleset_drift "firewall.nft differs from the repo's scripts/firewall-node.nft (older/hand-edited)" "scp scripts/firewall-node.nft node:/tmp/ && sed 's/define NXEON_AGENT_PORT = 8943/define NXEON_AGENT_PORT = ${EXP_AGENT_PORT}/' /tmp/firewall-node.nft > /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft && firewall-safe-apply.sh --apply"
      fi
    fi
    unit_state="$(systemctl show nxeon-firewall -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null)"
    [[ "$unit_state" == "active" ]] && pass fw.unit_state "nxeon-firewall.service ActiveState=active" \
      || warn fw.unit_state "nxeon-firewall.service is ${unit_state:-unknown} (cosmetic: ruleset is live via safe-apply) " "systemctl start nxeon-firewall   # idempotent, run AFTER --confirm"
    if systemctl is-active --quiet fail2ban && fail2ban-client status 2>/dev/null | grep -q sshd; then
      if [[ -n "$EXP_PRIMARY_IP" ]]; then
        if fail2ban-client get sshd ignoreip 2>/dev/null | grep -qF "$EXP_PRIMARY_IP"; then pass fw.fail2ban "fail2ban sshd jail active, primary in ignoreip"
        else warn fw.fail2ban "fail2ban sshd jail active but the primary (${EXP_PRIMARY_IP}) is NOT in ignoreip — a few failed logins from the primary bans it from this node" "fail2ban-client set sshd addignoreip ${EXP_PRIMARY_IP}; persist: add 'ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 ::1 ${EXP_PRIMARY_IP}' under [sshd] in /etc/fail2ban/jail.d/nxeon.conf"; fi
      else pass fw.fail2ban "fail2ban sshd jail active"; fi
    else fail fw.fail2ban "fail2ban not running / no sshd jail" "apt-get install -y fail2ban && cp deploy/fail2ban-nxeon.jail.conf /etc/fail2ban/jail.d/nxeon.conf && systemctl enable --now fail2ban"; fi

    # ----- agent.* -----------------------------------------------------------
    ENVF=/etc/nxeon/node-agent.env
    if [[ -f "$ENVF" ]]; then
      envperm="$(stat -c %a "$ENVF")"
      missk=""; for k in NXEON_AGENT_PORT NXEON_AGENT_TOKEN NXEON_AGENT_TLS_KEY NXEON_AGENT_TLS_CERT; do grep -q "^${k}=" "$ENVF" || missk="$missk $k"; done
      if [[ "$envperm" == "600" && -z "$missk" ]]; then pass agent.env "node-agent.env present, 0600, all keys set"
      else fail agent.env "node-agent.env perms=${envperm}, missing keys:${missk:- none}" "chmod 600 $ENVF; $FIXHINT"; fi
      AG_PORT="$(grep '^NXEON_AGENT_PORT=' "$ENVF" | cut -d= -f2)"
      fact agent_port "$AG_PORT"
      [[ "$AG_PORT" == "$EXP_AGENT_PORT" ]] && pass agent.port_cfg "agent port ${AG_PORT} matches expected" || fail agent.port_cfg "agent port ${AG_PORT} != expected ${EXP_AGENT_PORT} (DB Node.agentPort / firewall)" "align /etc/nxeon/node-agent.env, firewall.nft and Node.agentPort"
      kp="$(grep '^NXEON_AGENT_TLS_KEY=' "$ENVF" | cut -d= -f2)"; cp_="$(grep '^NXEON_AGENT_TLS_CERT=' "$ENVF" | cut -d= -f2)"
      if [[ -s "$kp" && -s "$cp_" && "$(stat -c %a "$kp")" == "600" ]]; then pass agent.tls "TLS key (0600) + cert present"
      else fail agent.tls "TLS key/cert missing or key not 0600 (${kp} / ${cp_})" "openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 3650 -keyout /etc/nxeon/node-agent.key.pem -out /etc/nxeon/node-agent.cert.pem -subj /CN=$(hostname)-node-agent && chmod 600 /etc/nxeon/node-agent.key.pem && systemctl restart nxeon-node-agent"; fi
      if systemctl is-active --quiet nxeon-node-agent && systemctl is-enabled --quiet nxeon-node-agent; then
        pass agent.service "nxeon-node-agent active + enabled"
        if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "[:*]${AG_PORT}\b"; then
          code_noauth="$(curl -sk -m5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://127.0.0.1:${AG_PORT}/v1/health" </dev/null)"
          TOK="$(grep '^NXEON_AGENT_TOKEN=' "$ENVF" | cut -d= -f2-)"
          code_auth="$(curl -sk -m5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOK}" "https://127.0.0.1:${AG_PORT}/v1/health" </dev/null)"
          TOK=""
          if [[ "$code_noauth" == "401" && "$code_auth" == "200" ]]; then pass agent.auth "agent listens on ${AG_PORT}: 401 without token, 200 with the token in node-agent.env"
          else fail agent.auth "agent health: no-token=${code_noauth} (want 401), with env token=${code_auth} (want 200)" "journalctl -u nxeon-node-agent -n 50; systemctl restart nxeon-node-agent"; fi
          fact agent_health_code "$code_auth"
        else fail agent.listening "nothing listening on tcp ${AG_PORT}" "systemctl restart nxeon-node-agent; journalctl -u nxeon-node-agent -n 50"; fi
      else fail agent.service "nxeon-node-agent not active/enabled" "systemctl enable --now nxeon-node-agent; journalctl -u nxeon-node-agent -n 50"; fi
    else
      fail agent.env "/etc/nxeon/node-agent.env missing — no node-agent on this node (NAT sync + per-VM cloud-init snippets use the degraded path)" "$FIXHINT"
    fi
    if have node; then
      nv="$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]' 2>/dev/null)"
      [[ "$nv" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( nv >= 18 )) && pass agent.node "Node.js $(node --version)" || fail agent.node "Node.js too old/broken (${nv:-?}); agent needs >= 18" "curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs"
    else fail agent.node "Node.js not installed" "curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs"; fi
    if [[ -n "$EXP_AGENT_SHA" ]]; then
      [[ "$(sha12 /opt/nxeon-agent/index.js)" == "$EXP_AGENT_SHA" ]] && pass agent.code_drift "agent index.js identical to the repo's node-agent/index.js" \
        || warn agent.code_drift "agent index.js differs from the repo version" "scp node-agent/index.js node:/opt/nxeon-agent/index.js && systemctl restart nxeon-node-agent"
    fi
    if [[ -n "$EXP_AGENT_UNIT_SHA" ]]; then
      [[ "$(sha12 /etc/systemd/system/nxeon-node-agent.service)" == "$EXP_AGENT_UNIT_SHA" ]] && pass agent.unit_drift "agent systemd unit identical to deploy/nxeon-node-agent.service" \
        || warn agent.unit_drift "agent systemd unit differs from deploy/nxeon-node-agent.service" "cp deploy/nxeon-node-agent.service /etc/systemd/system/ && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart nxeon-node-agent"
    fi
  fi

  # ======================= st.* ===============================================
  NVME="${NXEON_V_NVME:-vmdata}"; HDD="${NXEON_V_HDD:-vmdata-hdd}"
  stor_row() { pvesm status --storage "$1" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2{print $3, $6, $7}'; }  # status avail pct
  check_storage_basic() { # id label required-content
    local id="$1" lab="$2" req="$3" row st av pct cont c miss=""
    if ! grep -qE "^[a-z]+:[[:space:]]+${id}\$" "$STORAGE_CFG" 2>/dev/null; then fail "st.${lab}" "storage '${id}' not defined" "$FIXHINT"; return 1; fi
    row="$(stor_row "$id")"; st="${row%% *}"
    [[ "$st" == "active" ]] || { fail "st.${lab}" "storage '${id}' status=${st:-unknown}" "pvesm status; zpool status; mount | grep ${id}"; return 1; }
    cont="$(nxeon_storage_attr "$STORAGE_CFG" "$id" content)"
    for c in $req; do [[ ",${cont}," == *",${c},"* ]] || miss="$miss $c"; done
    if [[ -n "$miss" ]]; then fail "st.${lab}" "storage '${id}' content='${cont}' lacks:${miss}" "pvesm set ${id} --content $(echo "${cont}${miss// /,}" | tr -s ',' | sed 's/^,//;s/,,/,/g')"; return 1; fi
    pct="${row##* }"; pct="${pct%\%}"; pct="${pct%%.*}"
    if [[ "$pct" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( pct >= 92 )); then fail "st.${lab}" "storage '${id}' is ${pct}% full" "free space / add capacity"; return 1
    elif [[ "$pct" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( pct >= 80 )); then warn "st.${lab}" "storage '${id}' is ${pct}% full" "plan capacity"; return 0; fi
    pass "st.${lab}" "storage '${id}' active (${pct:-?}% used, content=${cont})"
  }
  check_storage_basic "$NVME" vm_storage "images rootdir"
  check_storage_basic "$HDD" hdd_storage "backup snippets" && {
    HDD_PATH="$(nxeon_storage_attr "$STORAGE_CFG" "$HDD" path)"
    fact hdd_path "$HDD_PATH"
    if [[ -n "$HDD_PATH" && -d "$HDD_PATH" ]]; then
      if [[ "$(stat -c %d "$HDD_PATH")" == "$(stat -c %d /)" ]]; then
        rt_total_gb="$(df -BG / | awk 'NR==2{gsub("G","",$2); print $2}')"
        fail st.hdd_not_root "'${HDD}' (${HDD_PATH}) lives ON THE ROOT FILESYSTEM (${rt_total_gb} GB, ${root_pct}% used): the nightly vzdump archives + customer backups will fill / and take Proxmox down" "On a ZFS node carve a dataset: POOL=\$(awk '/^zfspool: ${NVME}\$/{f=1} f&&/pool /{print \$2; exit}' /etc/pve/storage.cfg | cut -d/ -f1); mkdir /tank/backup.old && mv ${HDD_PATH}/* /tank/backup.old/; zfs create -o mountpoint=${HDD_PATH} \${POOL}/backup && mv /tank/backup.old/* ${HDD_PATH}/ && rmdir /tank/backup.old   # or re-run onboard-node.sh --carve-backup-dataset"
      else pass st.hdd_not_root "'${HDD}' (${HDD_PATH}) is on its own filesystem ($(findmnt -no FSTYPE -T "$HDD_PATH"), $(df -h "$HDD_PATH" | awk 'NR==2{print $2" total"}'))"; fi
    fi
  }
  if ! is_primary; then
    if grep -qE '^dir:[[:space:]]+backup$' "$STORAGE_CFG" && [[ "$(nxeon_storage_attr "$STORAGE_CFG" backup path)" == "$(nxeon_storage_attr "$STORAGE_CFG" "$HDD" path)" ]] \
       && [[ ",$(nxeon_storage_attr "$STORAGE_CFG" backup content)," == *",snippets,"* ]]; then
      pass st.backup_alias "'backup' snippets alias -> same path as ${HDD} (templates restored from the primary resolve cicustom)"
    else fail st.backup_alias "no 'backup' snippets-only alias storage pointing at the same path as ${HDD} — templates dumped from the primary (cicustom vendor=backup:...) cannot be backed up or restored here" "pvesm add dir backup --path $(nxeon_storage_attr "$STORAGE_CFG" "$HDD" path) --content snippets"; fi
  fi
  SNIPDIR="$(pvesm path "${HDD}:snippets/nxeon-vendor.yaml" 2>/dev/null)"
  if [[ -n "$SNIPDIR" && -f "$SNIPDIR" ]]; then
    want="$(nxeon_vendor_snippet | sha256sum | cut -c1-12)"
    if [[ "$(sha12 "$SNIPDIR")" == "$want" ]]; then pass st.vendor_snippet "nxeon-vendor.yaml present and byte-identical to the canonical snippet"
    else warn st.vendor_snippet "nxeon-vendor.yaml differs from the canonical snippet" "scripts/node-canon.sh: nxeon_vendor_snippet > ${SNIPDIR}   # or re-run onboard-node.sh --force-snippet"; fi
    [[ -w "$(dirname "$SNIPDIR")" ]] && pass st.snippet_dir "snippets dir writable ($(dirname "$SNIPDIR"))" || fail st.snippet_dir "snippets dir not writable" "chmod u+w $(dirname "$SNIPDIR")"
  else
    fail st.vendor_snippet "vendor snippet ${HDD}:snippets/nxeon-vendor.yaml missing — every clone boots without qemu-guest-agent/root SSH (Class B bug: the worker writes per-VM snippets through the node-agent, but templates reference this base one)" "mkdir -p \$(dirname \$(pvesm path ${HDD}:snippets/x)) && nxeon_vendor_snippet > ...   # or re-run onboard-node.sh"
  fi

  # ======================= tpl.* ==============================================
  for spec in "${NXEON_CANON_TEMPLATES[@]}"; do
    IFS='|' read -r tid tname _slug <<<"$spec"
    cfg="$(qm config "$tid" 2>/dev/null)"
    if [[ -z "$cfg" ]]; then
      fail "tpl.${tid}" "template ${tid} (${tname}) MISSING — any order for ${_slug} scheduled here fails at clone" "On the primary: scripts/export-templates.sh /root/nxeon-templates; scp /root/nxeon-templates/vzdump-qemu-${tid}-*.vma.zst node:/root/nxeon-templates/; on the node: scripts/onboard-node.sh --templates-dir /root/nxeon-templates (or: qmrestore <file> ${tid} --storage ${NVME}; qm template ${tid})"
      continue
    fi
    probs=""
    echo "$cfg" | grep -q '^template: 1' || probs="$probs not-a-template"
    echo "$cfg" | grep -qE "^name: ${tname}\$" || probs="$probs name!=${tname}"
    echo "$cfg" | grep -qE '^agent: (enabled=)?1' || probs="$probs agent-off"
    cic="$(echo "$cfg" | sed -n 's/^cicustom: vendor=\([^:]*\):.*/\1/p')"
    if [[ -z "$cic" ]]; then probs="$probs no-cicustom"
    elif ! grep -qE "^[a-z]+:[[:space:]]+${cic}\$" "$STORAGE_CFG"; then probs="$probs cicustom-storage-'${cic}'-undefined"; fi
    vol="$(echo "$cfg" | sed -n 's/^scsi0: \([^,]*\),.*/\1/p')"
    if [[ -z "$vol" ]] || ! pvesm path "$vol" >/dev/null 2>&1; then probs="$probs disk-missing(${vol:-none})"; fi
    if [[ -z "$probs" ]]; then pass "tpl.${tid}" "${tname}: template, agent on, disk ${vol}, cicustom storage '${cic}' resolves"
    else fail "tpl.${tid}" "${tname}:${probs}" "qm config ${tid}; fix with qm set ${tid} --agent enabled=1 --cicustom vendor=${HDD}:snippets/nxeon-vendor.yaml; qm template ${tid}   # missing disk => restore from the primary's dump"; fi
    fact "tplhash.${tid}" "$(echo "$cfg" | nxeon_normalize_template_config | sha256sum | cut -c1-10)"
  done
  tx="$(qm list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 && $1>=9000 && $1<9100{print $1}' | grep -vxFf <(nxeon_canon_template_ids) | tr '\n' ' ')"
  [[ -n "$tx" ]] && warn tpl.extra "VMIDs in the 9000 block that are not canonical templates: ${tx}(info: the primary also hosts coldemail-relay at 9010)" ""
  fact templates_present "$(qm list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 && $1>=9000 && $1<9010{print $1}' | tr '\n' ',')"

  # ======================= api.* ==============================================
  if have pveum && have python3; then
    ACL_JSON="$(pveum acl list --output-format json 2>/dev/null)"
    GRANTED_ROLE="$(printf '%s' "$ACL_JSON" | python3 -c "
import json,sys
try: acl=json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception: sys.exit(0)
roles=[a['roleid'] for a in acl if a.get('ugid')=='${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER}' and a.get('path')=='/' and a.get('propagate')]
print(roles[0] if roles else '')
" 2>/dev/null)"
    if [[ -z "$GRANTED_ROLE" ]]; then
      fail api.acl "no propagating role granted to ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER} at / — the platform token can do nothing" "pveum acl modify / --users ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER} --roles ${NXEON_CANON_ROLE}   # after: pveum role add ${NXEON_CANON_ROLE} --privs $(nxeon_role_privs_csv)"
    else
      pass api.acl "${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER} has role ${GRANTED_ROLE} at / (propagate)"
      fact role "$GRANTED_ROLE"
      priv_report="$(pveum role list --output-format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json,sys
want=set('''$(nxeon_role_privs_csv)'''.split(','))
roles=json.load(sys.stdin)
r=[x for x in roles if x['roleid']=='${GRANTED_ROLE}']
if not r: print('NOROLE'); sys.exit()
p=r[0].get('privs','')
have=set(p.split(',')) if isinstance(p,str) else set(p)
have.discard('')
print('MISSING=' + ','.join(sorted(want-have)))
print('EXTRA=' + ','.join(sorted(have-want)))
" 2>/dev/null)"
      miss_p="$(echo "$priv_report" | sed -n 's/^MISSING=//p')"; extra_p="$(echo "$priv_report" | sed -n 's/^EXTRA=//p')"
      if [[ -z "$miss_p" ]]; then pass api.role_privs "role ${GRANTED_ROLE} has all ${#NXEON_CANON_ROLE_PRIVS[@]} canonical privileges"
      else fail api.role_privs "role ${GRANTED_ROLE} is MISSING: ${miss_p}" "pveum role modify ${GRANTED_ROLE} --privs $(nxeon_role_privs_csv)   # (PVE replaces the list: always pass the full canonical set)"; fi
      [[ -n "$extra_p" ]] && warn api.role_extra "role ${GRANTED_ROLE} has non-canonical extra privileges: ${extra_p}" "review; canonical list is NXEON_CANON_ROLE_PRIVS in scripts/node-canon.sh"
      if ! is_primary && [[ "$GRANTED_ROLE" != "$NXEON_CANON_ROLE" ]]; then warn api.role_name "role is named ${GRANTED_ROLE}, canonical name on compute nodes is ${NXEON_CANON_ROLE}" "cosmetic; keep the name consistent so audits can grep it"; fi
    fi
    pveum user list --output-format json 2>/dev/null | grep -q "\"${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER}\"" && pass api.user "user ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER} exists" || fail api.user "user ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER} missing" "pveum user add ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER}"
    tk="$(pveum user token list "$NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER" --output-format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json,sys
try: t=json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception: sys.exit(0)
for x in t:
    if x.get('tokenid')=='${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME}': print('privsep=%s expire=%s'%(x.get('privsep'),x.get('expire')))
" 2>/dev/null)"
    if [[ -z "$tk" ]]; then fail api.token "token ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER}!${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME} does not exist" "pveum user token add ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER} ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME} --privsep 0   # secret shown ONCE -> paste into Admin > Nodes"
    elif [[ "$tk" == *"privsep=0"* && "$tk" == *"expire=0"* ]]; then pass api.token "token ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME} exists, privsep=0 (inherits the role), never expires"
    else fail api.token "token ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME}: ${tk} (want privsep=0 expire=0)" "pveum user token remove ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER} ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME} && pveum user token add ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER} ${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME} --privsep 0   # rotates the secret: update Node.tokenSecret (ASK the owner first on a live node)"; fi
    # EFFECTIVE permissions of the token itself at the paths the platform actually uses
    eff_check() { # path priv...
      local p="$1"; shift
      pveum user permissions "${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER}!${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME}" --path "$p" --output-format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json,sys
want='$*'.split()
try: d=json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception: print('ERR'); sys.exit()
priv=set()
for v in d.values(): priv|=set(v.keys())
print(','.join(w for w in want if w not in priv))
" 2>/dev/null
    }
    eff_bad=""
    for chk in "/sdn/zones/localnetwork/${BRIDGE}:SDN.Use" "/vms/9000:VM.Clone VM.GuestAgent.FileRead VM.GuestAgent.Audit VM.Backup VM.Config.Options" "/storage/${NVME}:Datastore.AllocateSpace Datastore.Audit" "/storage/${HDD}:Datastore.AllocateSpace Datastore.Audit" "/nodes/${PVE_NODE}:Sys.Audit Sys.Modify"; do
      p="${chk%%:*}"; ps="${chk#*:}"; m="$(eff_check "$p" $ps)"
      [[ -n "$m" ]] && eff_bad="$eff_bad ${p}[${m}]"
    done
    if [[ -z "$eff_bad" ]]; then pass api.effective "token's EFFECTIVE permissions OK at /sdn, /vms, /storage, /nodes (incl. VM.GuestAgent.FileRead + SDN.Use)"
    else fail api.effective "token lacks effective privileges:${eff_bad}" "pveum role modify ${GRANTED_ROLE:-$NXEON_CANON_ROLE} --privs $(nxeon_role_privs_csv); check 'pveum acl list' for a deny/narrower ACL"; fi
  else
    warn api.tools "pveum/python3 not available — API identity checks skipped" ""
  fi
  if [[ -n "$API_TOKEN" ]] && ! is_primary; then
    code="$(curl -sk -m8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: PVEAPIToken=${API_TOKEN}" "https://127.0.0.1:8006/api2/json/nodes/${PVE_NODE}/status" </dev/null)"
    [[ "$code" == "200" ]] && pass api.token_auth "API token authenticates against this node (GET /nodes/${PVE_NODE}/status = 200)" || fail api.token_auth "API token rejected: HTTP ${code}" "check Node.tokenSecret in Admin > Nodes vs the secret shown at token creation"
  fi

  # ======================= bk.* ===============================================
  bkmiss=""; for f in /opt/nxeon/scripts/backup-vms.sh /opt/nxeon/scripts/backup-pve-config.sh; do [[ -x "$f" ]] || bkmiss="$bkmiss $f"; done
  [[ -z "$bkmiss" ]] && pass bk.scripts "backup scripts installed + executable" || fail bk.scripts "missing/non-executable:${bkmiss}" "$FIXHINT"
  if [[ -f /etc/systemd/system/nxeon-backup-vms.timer && -f /etc/systemd/system/nxeon-backup-vms.service ]]; then
    ten="$(systemctl is-enabled nxeon-backup-vms.timer 2>/dev/null)"; tac="$(systemctl is-active nxeon-backup-vms.timer 2>/dev/null)"
    last="$(systemctl show nxeon-backup-vms.timer -p LastTriggerUSec --value 2>/dev/null)"
    nxt="$(systemctl show nxeon-backup-vms.timer -p NextElapseUSecRealtime --value 2>/dev/null)"
    if [[ "$ten" != "enabled" || "$tac" != "active" ]]; then
      fail bk.timer "nxeon-backup-vms.timer enabled=${ten} active=${tac} — it will NEVER fire (this node's guests have no backups; node-2 sat 19 days like this)" "systemctl enable --now nxeon-backup-vms.timer && systemctl start --no-block nxeon-backup-vms.service"
    elif [[ -z "$nxt" ]]; then fail bk.timer "timer active but has no next elapse" "systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart nxeon-backup-vms.timer"
    else
      pass bk.timer "timer enabled + active, next run ${nxt}"
    fi
    if [[ -n "$last" ]]; then
      last_s="$(date -d "$last" +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"; age_h=$(( ( $(date +%s) - last_s ) / 3600 ))
      (( age_h <= NXEON_CANON_BACKUP_STALE_HOURS )) && pass bk.last_trigger "timer last fired ${age_h}h ago" || fail bk.last_trigger "timer last fired ${age_h}h ago (> ${NXEON_CANON_BACKUP_STALE_HOURS}h)" "systemctl start --no-block nxeon-backup-vms.service; journalctl -u nxeon-backup-vms -n 50"
    else warn bk.last_trigger "timer has never fired yet (fine within 24h of onboarding: run 'systemctl start --no-block nxeon-backup-vms.service' for a first pass)" ""; fi
    res_="$(systemctl show nxeon-backup-vms.service -p Result --value 2>/dev/null)"
    [[ "$res_" == "success" ]] && pass bk.last_result "last backup service run: success" || fail bk.last_result "last backup service run result=${res_}" "journalctl -u nxeon-backup-vms -n 80"
  else fail bk.units "nxeon-backup-vms.service/.timer not installed — zero local backups for this node's guests" "$FIXHINT"; fi
  PLATDIR="${HDD_PATH:-/tank/backup}/platform"
  if [[ -d "$PLATDIR" ]]; then
    newest="$(find "$PLATDIR" -maxdepth 1 \( -name 'vzdump-qemu-*.vma*' -o -name 'host-config-*.tar.gz' \) -printf '%T@\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d. -f1)"
    if [[ -n "$newest" ]]; then
      age=$(( ( $(date +%s) - newest ) / 3600 ))
      (( age <= NXEON_CANON_BACKUP_STALE_HOURS )) && pass bk.fresh "newest platform archive is ${age}h old" || fail bk.fresh "newest platform archive is ${age}h old (> ${NXEON_CANON_BACKUP_STALE_HOURS}h) — backups are stale" "systemctl start --no-block nxeon-backup-vms.service; journalctl -u nxeon-backup-vms -n 80"
    else warn bk.fresh "no platform archives in ${PLATDIR} yet" "systemctl start --no-block nxeon-backup-vms.service"; fi
  else warn bk.fresh "${PLATDIR} does not exist yet (created by the first backup run)" "systemctl start --no-block nxeon-backup-vms.service"; fi

  exit 0
fi

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LOCAL (wrapper) PART — runs where you invoked it (normally the primary)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$SELF" | sed -n '2,200p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' | head -75; }

ALL=0; FORCE_PRIMARY=0; NODE_NUM=""; PRIMARY_IP=""; AGENT_PORT=""; API_TOKEN="${NXEON_VERIFY_API_TOKEN:-}"
SSH_USER=root; SSH_OPTS=""; NO_DB=0; QUIET=0; STRICT=0; TARGET=""
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --all) ALL=1; shift ;;
    --primary) FORCE_PRIMARY=1; shift ;;
    --node-num) NODE_NUM="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --primary-ip) PRIMARY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --agent-port) AGENT_PORT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --api-token) API_TOKEN="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --ssh-user) SSH_USER="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --ssh-opts) SSH_OPTS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --no-db) NO_DB=1; shift ;;
    --quiet) QUIET=1; shift ;;
    --strict) STRICT=1; shift ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    -*) echo "unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *) TARGET="$1"; shift ;;
  esac
done
[[ "$ALL" == 1 || -n "$TARGET" ]] || { usage >&2; exit 2; }

# shellcheck source=scripts/node-canon.sh
source "$CANON" || { echo "cannot source $CANON" >&2; exit 2; }

if [[ -t 1 ]]; then C_OK=$'\033[32m'; C_WARN=$'\033[33m'; C_FAIL=$'\033[31m'; C_DIM=$'\033[2m'; C_OFF=$'\033[0m'; else C_OK=""; C_WARN=""; C_FAIL=""; C_DIM=""; C_OFF=""; fi

# ---- DB access (primary only; absent elsewhere => db.* checks skipped) ------
DB_MODE=""
if [[ "$NO_DB" != 1 ]]; then
  if command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ -n "${DATABASE_URL:-}" ]] && psql "$DATABASE_URL" -Atc 'select 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then DB_MODE=url
  elif command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo -n -u postgres psql "${NXEON_DB:-nxeon}" -Atc 'select 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then DB_MODE=sudo
  elif command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ "$(id -u)" == 0 ]] && su -s /bin/sh postgres -c "psql ${NXEON_DB:-nxeon} -Atc 'select 1'" >/dev/null 2>&1; then DB_MODE=su; fi
fi
db_q() { # sql -> unaligned rows, '|' separated
  case "$DB_MODE" in
    url)  psql "$DATABASE_URL" -At -F'|' -c "$1" 2>/dev/null ;;
    sudo) sudo -n -u postgres psql "${NXEON_DB:-nxeon}" -At -F'|' -c "$1" 2>/dev/null ;;
    su)   su -s /bin/sh postgres -c "psql ${NXEON_DB:-nxeon} -At -F'|' -c \"$1\"" 2>/dev/null ;;
  esac
}

safe_ip() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$ ]]; }
local_ips() { hostname -I 2>/dev/null; }
is_local_target() { local t="$1" ip; [[ "$t" == local ]] && return 0; for ip in $(local_ips); do [[ "$ip" == "$t" ]] && return 0; done; return 1; }

# Primary's public IP + public key (needed by the allowlist/ssh-key checks)
if [[ -z "$PRIMARY_IP" && -n "$DB_MODE" ]]; then PRIMARY_IP="$(db_q 'select "publicIp" from "Node" where "isPrimary" limit 1')"; fi
if [[ -z "$PRIMARY_IP" ]] && command -v pveversion >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ -s /etc/nxeon/admin-ips.nft || -d /opt/nxeon/app ]]; then :; fi
PRIMARY_KEY=""
for k in /root/.ssh/id_rsa.pub /root/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub; do [[ -s "$k" ]] && { PRIMARY_KEY="$(awk '{print $2}' "$k" | head -1)"; break; }; done

# Expected repo-file digests (drift checks)
sha12() { sha256sum "$1" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-12; }
repo_agent_sha="$(sha12 "$REPO_DIR/node-agent/index.js")"
repo_unit_sha="$(sha12 "$REPO_DIR/deploy/nxeon-node-agent.service")"

declare -A FACT=()
STATUS_FILE="$(mktemp)"; trap 'rm -f "$STATUS_FILE" "$STATUS_FILE".*' EXIT
FAILS=0; WARNS=0; PASSES=0

emit() { printf 'RESULT|%s|%s|%s|%s\n' "$1" "$2" "${3//|//}" "${4//|//}" >>"$OUT"; }

# run the node-side checks against one target; appends raw lines to $OUT
collect_remote() { # target profile node_num agent_port fw_sha
  local target="$1" profile="$2" nn="$3" ap="$4" fwsha="$5" envs payload b64
  envs="NXEON_V_REMOTE=1 NXEON_V_PROFILE=${profile} NXEON_V_AGENT_PORT=${ap}"
  [[ -n "$PRIMARY_IP" ]] && safe_ip "$PRIMARY_IP" && envs+=" NXEON_V_PRIMARY_IP=${PRIMARY_IP}"
  [[ -n "$nn" && "$nn" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && envs+=" NXEON_V_NODE_NUM=${nn}"
  [[ -n "$PRIMARY_KEY" && "$PRIMARY_KEY" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$ ]] && envs+=" NXEON_V_PRIMARY_KEY=${PRIMARY_KEY}"
  [[ -n "$fwsha" ]] && envs+=" NXEON_V_FW_SHA=${fwsha}"
  [[ -n "$repo_agent_sha" ]] && envs+=" NXEON_V_AGENT_SHA=${repo_agent_sha}"
  [[ -n "$repo_unit_sha" ]] && envs+=" NXEON_V_AGENT_UNIT_SHA=${repo_unit_sha}"
  if [[ -n "$API_TOKEN" && "$API_TOKEN" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9@!._=-]+$ ]]; then envs+=" NXEON_V_API_TOKEN=${API_TOKEN}"; fi
  if is_local_target "$target"; then
    env $envs bash "$SELF" 2>&1
  else
    safe_ip "$target" || { echo "RESULT|FAIL|verify.target|'${target}' is not a valid IPv4 address|"; return; }
    payload="$(cat "$CANON"; echo; cat "$SELF")"
    b64="$(printf '%s' "$payload" | base64 -w0)"
    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
    ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new $SSH_OPTS "${SSH_USER}@${target}" \
      "env ${envs} bash -c \"\$(echo ${b64} | base64 -d)\"" 2>&1 </dev/null \
      || echo "RESULT|FAIL|verify.ssh|ssh to ${SSH_USER}@${target} failed (exit $?)|Check the primary's key is in the node's authorized_keys and the firewall admin allowlist contains the primary: ssh ${SSH_USER}@${target} true"
  fi
}

verify_one() { # target [name]
  local target="$1" nm="${2:-}" profile=compute row="" ip nn="${NODE_NUM}" ap="${AGENT_PORT}" fwsha=""
  OUT="$(mktemp "$STATUS_FILE.XXXX")"
  FACT=()
  # --- resolve via DB ---
  local dbname="" dbip="" dbprim="f"
  if [[ -n "$DB_MODE" ]]; then
    if safe_ip "$target"; then row="$(db_q "select name,\"publicIp\",\"isPrimary\" from \"Node\" where \"publicIp\"='${target}'")"
    elif [[ "$target" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ && "$target" != local ]]; then row="$(db_q "select name,\"publicIp\",\"isPrimary\" from \"Node\" where name='${target}'")"
    fi
    if [[ -n "$row" ]]; then IFS='|' read -r dbname dbip dbprim <<<"$row"; fi
  fi
  if [[ "$target" != local ]] && ! safe_ip "$target"; then
    [[ -n "$dbip" ]] && target="$dbip" || { echo "cannot resolve '${target}' (no DB, not an IP)" >&2; return 2; }
  fi
  [[ -z "$dbname" && "$target" == local && -n "$DB_MODE" ]] && for ip in $(local_ips); do
    row="$(db_q "select name,\"publicIp\",\"isPrimary\" from \"Node\" where \"publicIp\"='${ip}'")"; [[ -n "$row" ]] && { IFS='|' read -r dbname dbip dbprim <<<"$row"; break; }; done
  [[ "$dbprim" == "t" || "$FORCE_PRIMARY" == 1 ]] && profile=primary
  [[ -z "$nm" ]] && nm="${dbname:-$target}"
  if [[ -z "$nn" && "$dbname" =~ ^node-([0-9]+)$ ]]; then nn="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"; fi
  [[ "$profile" == primary && -z "$nn" ]] && nn=1
  if [[ -z "$ap" && -n "$DB_MODE" && -n "$dbname" ]]; then ap="$(db_q "select \"agentPort\" from \"Node\" where name='${dbname}'")"; fi
  ap="${ap:-8943}"
  if [[ -f "$REPO_DIR/scripts/firewall-node.nft" ]]; then
    fwsha="$(sed "s/define NXEON_AGENT_PORT = 8943/define NXEON_AGENT_PORT = ${ap}/" "$REPO_DIR/scripts/firewall-node.nft" | sha256sum | cut -c1-12)"
  fi
  [[ "$profile" == primary ]] && fwsha=""

  collect_remote "$target" "$profile" "$nn" "$ap" "$fwsha" >>"$OUT"

  # absorb FACT lines
  local kind a b c d
  while IFS='|' read -r kind a b; do [[ "$kind" == FACT ]] && FACT["$a"]="$b"; done <"$OUT"

  # ---- primary-side checks that need facts ----------------------------------
  if [[ "$profile" == compute ]] && ! grep -q '^RESULT|FAIL|verify\.ssh' "$OUT"; then
    # reachability of the Proxmox API + node-agent from THIS (primary) host
    local pip="${FACT[public_ip]:-$target}" code
    code="$(curl -sk -m8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://${pip}:8006/api2/json/version" </dev/null)"
    if [[ "$code" == 401 || "$code" == 200 ]]; then emit PASS net.api_reachable "Proxmox API https://${pip}:8006 reachable from here (HTTP ${code})"
    else emit FAIL net.api_reachable "Proxmox API https://${pip}:8006 NOT reachable from here (HTTP ${code:-none}) — firewall admin allowlist or pveproxy" "On the node: /opt/nxeon/scripts/admin-ip.sh add ${PRIMARY_IP:-<primary-ip>}; systemctl status pveproxy"; fi
    code="$(curl -sk -m8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://${pip}:${ap}/v1/health" </dev/null)"
    if [[ "$code" == 401 ]]; then emit PASS net.agent_reachable "node-agent https://${pip}:${ap} reachable from here (401 = alive, token required)"
    else emit FAIL net.agent_reachable "node-agent https://${pip}:${ap} NOT reachable from here (HTTP ${code:-none})" "firewall agent allowlist must contain the primary; systemctl status nxeon-node-agent"; fi
  fi
  # template drift vs the reference node (this host, when it is the primary)
  if [[ "$profile" == compute ]] && command -v qm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    local tid ref drift="" cmp=0
    for tid in $(nxeon_canon_template_ids); do
      [[ -n "${FACT[tplhash.$tid]:-}" ]] || continue
      ref="$(qm config "$tid" 2>/dev/null | nxeon_normalize_template_config | sha256sum | cut -c1-10)"
      [[ "$ref" == "e3b0c44298" ]] && continue
      cmp=$((cmp + 1))
      [[ "${FACT[tplhash.$tid]}" == "$ref" ]] || drift+=" $tid"
    done
    if (( cmp == 0 )); then :
    elif [[ -z "$drift" ]]; then emit PASS tpl.parity "all ${cmp} templates identical to the primary's (normalised: MAC/uuid ignored, cicustom storage folded)"
    else emit WARN tpl.parity "templates differ from the primary's config:${drift}" "diff <(qm config ID | sort) <(ssh node qm config ID | sort); re-clone from a primary vzdump (scripts/export-templates.sh) if the difference is not cosmetic"; fi
  fi

  # ---- db.* ------------------------------------------------------------------
  if [[ -n "$DB_MODE" ]]; then
    db_checks "$profile" "$nm" "$target"
  else
    emit WARN db.skipped "no database reachable from this host — Node-row / OsTemplate / region checks skipped (run on the primary)" ""
  fi

  # ---- render ------------------------------------------------------------------
  render_one "$nm" "$target" "$profile"
}

db_checks() { # profile name ip
  local profile="$1" nm="$2" ip="$3" pip="${FACT[public_ip]:-$3}" r
  r="$(db_q "select name,\"pveNode\",\"publicIp\",bridge,\"subnetPrefix\",\"ipStart\",\"ipEnd\",\"sshPortStart\",\"sshPortEnd\",\"natChain\",\"storageNvme\",\"storageHdd\",\"capacityRamMB\",coalesce(\"monthlyCostCents\"::text,''),\"isPrimary\",provider,region,coalesce(\"providerServerId\",''),\"agentPort\",(\"agentTokenEnc\" is not null),\"apiUrl\",\"tokenId\",enabled,status,\"acceptsProvisions\" from \"Node\" where \"publicIp\"='${pip}' limit 1")"
  if [[ -z "$r" ]]; then
    emit WARN db.row "no Node row with publicIp ${pip} — expected before you press 'Add node' (do that last, with enabled=false)" "Admin > Compute nodes > Add node (values printed by onboard-node.sh)"
    return
  fi
  local name pveNode publicIp bridge subnetPrefix ipStart ipEnd sshS sshE natChain nvme hdd cap cost isPrim provider region psid agentPort hasTok apiUrl tokenId enabled status accepts
  IFS='|' read -r name pveNode publicIp bridge subnetPrefix ipStart ipEnd sshS sshE natChain nvme hdd cap cost isPrim provider region psid agentPort hasTok apiUrl tokenId enabled status accepts <<<"$r"
  emit PASS db.row "Node row '${name}' found (provider=${provider} region=${region} enabled=${enabled} status=${status} acceptsProvisions=${accepts})"
  local bad=""
  [[ "$pveNode" == "${FACT[hostname]:-$pveNode}" ]] || bad+=" pveNode=${pveNode}!=${FACT[hostname]}"
  [[ "$apiUrl" == "https://${pip}:8006" || "$apiUrl" == "https://127.0.0.1:8006" && "$isPrim" == t ]] || bad+=" apiUrl=${apiUrl}"
  [[ "$tokenId" == "${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER}!${NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME}" ]] || bad+=" tokenId=${tokenId}"
  [[ "$bridge" == "vmbr1" ]] || bad+=" bridge=${bridge}"
  if [[ -n "${FACT[vmbr1_addr]:-}" ]]; then
    local want_prefix; want_prefix="$(echo "${FACT[vmbr1_addr]}" | awk -F. '{print $1"."$2"."$3"."}')"
    [[ "$subnetPrefix" == "$want_prefix" ]] || bad+=" subnetPrefix=${subnetPrefix}!=${want_prefix}"
  fi
  [[ -z "${FACT[exp_chain]:-}" || "$natChain" == "${FACT[exp_chain]}" ]] || bad+=" natChain=${natChain}!=${FACT[exp_chain]}"
  [[ "$nvme" == "vmdata" ]] || bad+=" storageNvme=${nvme}"
  [[ "$hdd" == "vmdata-hdd" || "$isPrim" == t ]] || bad+=" storageHdd=${hdd}"
  (( ipStart >= 2 && ipEnd <= 254 && ipStart < ipEnd )) || bad+=" ipRange=${ipStart}-${ipEnd}"
  (( sshS >= 1024 && sshE <= 65535 && sshS < sshE )) || bad+=" sshPorts=${sshS}-${sshE}"
  if [[ -z "$bad" ]]; then emit PASS db.fields "pveNode/apiUrl/tokenId/bridge/subnet/natChain/storages/IP+SSH ranges all match the live node"
  else emit FAIL db.fields "Node row disagrees with the live node:${bad}" "Admin > Compute nodes > ${name} > Edit (fix the listed fields)"; fi
  # duplicates across Node rows (islands must be unique)
  local dup; dup="$(db_q "select 'subnetPrefix='||\"subnetPrefix\" from \"Node\" group by \"subnetPrefix\" having count(*)>1 union all select 'natChain='||\"natChain\" from \"Node\" group by \"natChain\" having count(*)>1 union all select 'publicIp='||\"publicIp\" from \"Node\" group by \"publicIp\" having count(*)>1" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  [[ -z "$dup" ]] && emit PASS db.unique "no duplicate subnetPrefix/natChain/publicIp across Node rows" || emit FAIL db.unique "duplicate island values across nodes: ${dup}" "give every node a unique --node-num (10.20.(N-1).0/24, NXEON_FWD_N<N>)"
  # capacity
  if [[ -n "${FACT[mem_total_mb]:-}" ]]; then
    local want diff; want="$(nxeon_capacity_ram_mb "${FACT[mem_total_mb]}")"; diff=$(( cap > want ? cap - want : want - cap ))
    if (( diff <= 4000 )); then emit PASS db.capacity "capacityRamMB=${cap} (physical $((${FACT[mem_total_mb]})) MB - 8 GB reserve = ${want})"
    else emit WARN db.capacity "capacityRamMB=${cap} but physical RAM suggests ~${want} (MemTotal ${FACT[mem_total_mb]} MB - 8000)" "Admin > Compute nodes > ${name} > Edit > Capacity RAM = ${want}"; fi
  fi
  [[ -n "$cost" ]] && emit PASS db.cost "monthlyCostCents=${cost}" || emit WARN db.cost "monthlyCostCents is empty (cost/margin dashboards blind)" "Admin > Compute nodes > ${name} > Edit > Monthly cost"
  if [[ -n "$psid" ]]; then
    if [[ "$provider" == OVH && ! "$psid" =~ ^ns[0-9]+\.ip-[0-9-]+\.net$ ]]; then emit FAIL db.provider_id "OVH providerServerId '${psid}' is not a service hostname like ns5013314.ip-15-235-145.net (a numeric order id breaks dedicated-IP allocation)" "GET /dedicated/server on the OVH account; use the hostname matching ${pip}"
    elif [[ "$provider" == HETZNER && ! "$psid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then emit FAIL db.provider_id "Hetzner providerServerId '${psid}' must be the numeric server number" "Robot panel > Servers"
    else emit PASS db.provider_id "providerServerId=${psid} plausible for ${provider}"; fi
  else emit WARN db.provider_id "providerServerId empty — dedicated-IP ordering for this node will fail" "Admin > Compute nodes > ${name} > Edit (OVH hostname from GET /dedicated/server; Hetzner server number)"; fi
  if nxeon_region_valid "$provider" "$region"; then emit PASS db.region "region ${region} is valid for ${provider} (lib/node-regions.ts)"; else emit FAIL db.region "region '${region}' invalid for ${provider}" "use a code from NODE_REGIONS in lib/node-regions.ts"; fi
  local miss_files=""
  for f in lib/node-regions.ts lib/nx/catalog.ts lib/marketing/locationLandings.ts; do
    [[ -f "$REPO_DIR/$f" ]] && ! grep -q "\b${region}\b" "$REPO_DIR/$f" && miss_files+=" $f"
  done
  [[ -z "$miss_files" ]] && emit PASS db.region_code "region ${region} referenced in node-regions / nx catalog / location landings" \
    || emit WARN db.region_code "region ${region} not found in:${miss_files} — wizard/marketing will show a blank/generic location" "see docs 'Adding node N' step 6 (region + marketing pages): add ${region} to REGION_LABELS/REGION_COUNTRY/REGION_COORDS, lib/nx/catalog.ts area table, locationLandings.ts"
  if [[ "$profile" == compute ]]; then
    [[ "$hasTok" == t ]] && emit PASS db.agent_token "Node.agentTokenEnc is set" || emit FAIL db.agent_token "Node.agentTokenEnc is empty — worker cannot talk to the agent (degraded NAT/snippets)" "Admin > Compute nodes > ${name} > Edit > Agent token (value from /etc/nxeon/node-agent.env on the node)"
    [[ -z "${FACT[agent_port]:-}" || "$agentPort" == "${FACT[agent_port]}" ]] && emit PASS db.agent_port "Node.agentPort=${agentPort} matches the node" || emit FAIL db.agent_port "Node.agentPort=${agentPort} but the node listens on ${FACT[agent_port]}" "Admin > Compute nodes > ${name} > Edit > Agent port"
  fi
  # every active OsTemplate vmid must exist on the node
  local need have_ids missing=""
  need="$(db_q 'select distinct coalesce("baseVmid",vmid) from "OsTemplate" where active order by 1' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  have_ids=",${FACT[templates_present]:-},"
  for v in $need; do [[ "$have_ids" == *",${v},"* ]] || missing+=" $v"; done
  if [[ -z "$missing" ]]; then emit PASS db.os_templates "every active OsTemplate base VMID (${need% }) exists on this node"
  else
    local sev=FAIL; [[ "$accepts" != t || "$enabled" != t ]] && sev=WARN
    emit "$sev" db.os_templates "active OsTemplate VMIDs missing on this node:${missing} (acceptsProvisions=${accepts}, enabled=${enabled}) — scheduleNode() does not check templates, so an order for those OSes placed here FAILS at clone" "Copy the templates (see tpl.* fixes) OR set acceptsProvisions=false on ${name} until done"
  fi
  # memory sampling path (needs VM.GuestAgent.FileRead + the guest agent)
  local nsrv nsamp
  nsrv="$(db_q "select count(*) from \"Server\" s join \"Node\" n on n.id=s.\"nodeId\" where n.\"publicIp\"='${pip}' and s.status='RUNNING'")"
  if [[ "${nsrv:-0}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( nsrv > 0 )); then
    nsamp="$(db_q "select count(distinct m.\"serverId\") from \"ServerMemSample\" m join \"Server\" s on s.id=m.\"serverId\" join \"Node\" n on n.id=s.\"nodeId\" where n.\"publicIp\"='${pip}' and s.status='RUNNING' and m.ts>now()-interval '60 minutes'")"
    if (( ${nsamp:-0} >= nsrv )); then emit PASS db.mem_samples "in-guest memory samples flowing for all ${nsrv} running servers (last 60 min)"
    elif (( ${nsamp:-0} > 0 )); then emit WARN db.mem_samples "memory samples for ${nsamp}/${nsrv} running servers in the last 60 min (others: guest agent down/old template?)" "On the node: qm agent <vmid> ping; check VM.GuestAgent.FileRead (api.effective)"
    else emit FAIL db.mem_samples "no memory samples in 60 min for ${nsrv} running server(s) — VM.GuestAgent.FileRead missing or worker memory sampler broken" "fix api.role_privs/api.effective first; then journalctl -u nxeon-worker | grep -i memsample"; fi
  else emit PASS db.mem_samples "no running servers on this node yet (nothing to sample)"; fi
}

render_one() { # name target profile
  local nm="$1" target="$2" profile="$3" kind st id msg fix n_p=0 n_w=0 n_f=0 sect last=""
  echo
  echo "== verify-node: ${nm} (${target}, profile=${profile}) =="
  while IFS='|' read -r kind st id msg fix; do
    [[ "$kind" == RESULT ]] || { [[ "$kind" == FACT ]] || [[ -z "$kind" ]] || echo "  ${C_DIM}${kind}${st:+|$st}${id:+|$id}${msg:+|$msg}${C_OFF}"; continue; }
    sect="${id%%.*}"
    case "$st" in
      PASS) n_p=$((n_p + 1)); [[ "$QUIET" == 1 ]] && continue; printf '  %s[PASS]%s %-22s %s\n' "$C_OK" "$C_OFF" "$id" "$msg" ;;
      WARN) n_w=$((n_w + 1)); printf '  %s[WARN]%s %-22s %s\n' "$C_WARN" "$C_OFF" "$id" "$msg"; [[ -n "$fix" ]] && printf '           fix: %s\n' "$fix" ;;
      FAIL) n_f=$((n_f + 1)); printf '  %s[FAIL]%s %-22s %s\n' "$C_FAIL" "$C_OFF" "$id" "$msg"; [[ -n "$fix" ]] && printf '           fix: %s\n' "$fix" ;;
    esac
    # remember for the matrix
    [[ "$st" == FAIL ]] && echo "${nm}|FAIL|${id}" >>"$STATUS_FILE.matrix"
    [[ "$st" == WARN ]] && echo "${nm}|WARN|${id}" >>"$STATUS_FILE.matrix"
  done <"$OUT"
  echo "  -- ${nm}: ${n_p} pass, ${n_w} warn, ${n_f} fail"
  PASSES=$((PASSES + n_p)); WARNS=$((WARNS + n_w)); FAILS=$((FAILS + n_f))
  echo "${nm}|${n_p}|${n_w}|${n_f}" >>"$STATUS_FILE.summary"
}

: >"$STATUS_FILE.matrix"; : >"$STATUS_FILE.summary"
if [[ "$ALL" == 1 ]]; then
  [[ -n "$DB_MODE" ]] || { echo "--all needs a reachable DB (run on the primary)" >&2; exit 2; }
  while IFS='|' read -r n ip; do
    [[ -n "$n" ]] || continue
    t="$ip"; for lip in $(local_ips); do [[ "$lip" == "$ip" ]] && t=local; done
    verify_one "$t" "$n"
  done < <(db_q 'select name,"publicIp" from "Node" order by "createdAt"')
  echo; echo "== matrix (non-PASS findings per node) =="
  ids="$(cut -d'|' -f3 "$STATUS_FILE.matrix" | sort -u)"
  names="$(cut -d'|' -f1 "$STATUS_FILE.summary" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  printf '%-24s' check; for n in $names; do printf '%-9s' "$n"; done; echo
  for i in $ids; do
    printf '%-24s' "$i"
    for n in $names; do
      s="$(grep -F "${n}|" "$STATUS_FILE.matrix" | grep -F "|${i}" | head -1 | cut -d'|' -f2)"
      case "$s" in FAIL) printf '%s%-9s%s' "$C_FAIL" FAIL "$C_OFF" ;; WARN) printf '%s%-9s%s' "$C_WARN" warn "$C_OFF" ;; *) printf '%-9s' . ;; esac
    done; echo
  done
  echo; echo "per-node totals (pass/warn/fail):"; while IFS='|' read -r n p w f; do printf '  %-10s %3s / %3s / %3s\n' "$n" "$p" "$w" "$f"; done <"$STATUS_FILE.summary"
else
  verify_one "$TARGET" || exit 2
fi

echo
echo "RESULT: ${PASSES} pass, ${WARNS} warn, ${FAILS} fail"
if (( FAILS > 0 )); then echo "NOT READY — fix every FAIL above (each shows its remediation), then re-run."; exit 1; fi
if (( STRICT == 1 && WARNS > 0 )); then echo "WARNs present (--strict)."; exit 1; fi
echo "READY."
exit 0

content.thinking:
I'm spotting an awkward conditional check for primary status that should be simplified to a cleaner negation, and reviewing how the remote script handles self-referencing paths when invoked through a base64-decoded bash command.

Since the wrapper's dead code after `exit 0` won't be executed in incremental bash parsing, that's fine, and the local-target path just runs the same script with exported env vars. #!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# Nxeon — export the OS templates (VMID 9000-9009) from the PRIMARY so a new node
# can be built from byte-identical images.
# =============================================================================
# Run ON THE PRIMARY. Read-only with respect to the templates themselves
# (vzdump of a stopped template does not modify it). Writes archives + a
# SHA256SUMS manifest into OUT_DIR, then prints the exact rsync line.
#
#   scripts/export-templates.sh [OUT_DIR] [--ids "9000 9001 ..."]
#
# OUT_DIR default: /tank/backup/nxeon-templates-export   (ZFS, plenty of space —
# NOT /root: the primary's root fs runs ~95% full and 10 templates are several GB)
#
# Why not build the templates fresh on each node (scripts/build-templates.sh)?
# Because that downloads whatever "latest" cloud image exists TODAY, so node N
# ends up with a different OS patch level (and different template config) than
# node 1 — and build-templates.sh only knows 9002-9004 anyway. Copying means
# every customer gets the identical image regardless of which node they land on.
# onboard-node.sh --templates-dir <dir> restores from this export and verify-node.sh
# (tpl.parity) proves the result is identical to the primary.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
# shellcheck source=scripts/node-canon.sh
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/node-canon.sh"

OUT_DIR="/tank/backup/nxeon-templates-export"
IDS=""
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case "$1" in
    --ids) IDS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '2,25p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"; exit 0 ;;
    -*) echo "unknown option: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    *) OUT_DIR="$1"; shift ;;
  esac
done
[[ -z "$IDS" ]] && IDS="$(nxeon_canon_template_ids | tr '\n' ' ')"

[[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]] || { echo "run as root on the primary" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v vzdump >/dev/null || { echo "vzdump not found — run this on a Proxmox host" >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"

# refuse to fill a small filesystem
avail_kb="$(df -Pk "$OUT_DIR" | awk 'NR==2{print $4}')"
if (( avail_kb < 20 * 1024 * 1024 )); then
  echo "less than 20 GB free under ${OUT_DIR} ($((avail_kb / 1024 / 1024)) GB) — choose another OUT_DIR" >&2
  exit 1
fi

for id in $IDS; do
  [[ "$id" =~ ^90[0-9][0-9]$ ]] || { echo "refusing non-template id: $id" >&2; exit 2; }
  if [[ ! -r "/etc/pve/qemu-server/${id}.conf" ]]; then echo "skip ${id}: not present on this host"; continue; fi
  grep -q '^template: 1' "/etc/pve/qemu-server/${id}.conf" || { echo "skip ${id}: not a template"; continue; }
  # drop any older archive of this id so the newest one is unambiguous
  find "$OUT_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "vzdump-qemu-${id}-*" -delete
  echo "== dumping template ${id}"
  vzdump "$id" --dumpdir "$OUT_DIR" --mode stop --compress zstd
done

( cd "$OUT_DIR" && sha256sum vzdump-qemu-*.vma.zst > SHA256SUMS )
echo
echo "Exported:"; ls -lh "$OUT_DIR"/vzdump-qemu-*.vma.zst
echo
echo "Next (replace NODE_IP; the node needs the files on a filesystem with ~15 GB free —"
echo "its backup volume, NOT a 20 GB root fs):"
echo "  rsync -avP ${OUT_DIR}/ root@NODE_IP:/tank/backup/nxeon-templates-import/"
echo "  ssh root@NODE_IP 'cd /opt/nxeon/scripts && ./onboard-node.sh --node-num N --primary-ip <PRIMARY_IP> --templates-dir /tank/backup/nxeon-templates-import'"

# =============================================================================
# Pure(ish) helpers used by onboard-node.sh — each takes explicit paths/args so
# scripts/test-node-scripts.sh can exercise them against a temp dir.
# =============================================================================

nxeon_valid_ipv4() { [[ "$1" =~ ^([0-9]{1,3})\.([0-9]{1,3})\.([0-9]{1,3})\.([0-9]{1,3})$ ]] && (( BASH_REMATCH[1] <= 255 && BASH_REMATCH[2] <= 255 && BASH_REMATCH[3] <= 255 && BASH_REMATCH[4] <= 255 )); }
# an IPv4 or IPv4/CIDR that is safe to embed in an nft file
nxeon_valid_ipv4_or_cidr() { local a="${1%%/*}" m=""; [[ "$1" == */* ]] && m="${1##*/}"; nxeon_valid_ipv4 "$a" || return 1; [[ -z "$m" ]] || { [[ "$m" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( m >= 0 && m <= 32 )); }; }

# First field of $SSH_CONNECTION (the client IPv4), or empty. Used to seed the
# admin allowlist with the operator's own address, because applying the node
# firewall WITHOUT it locks the operator out of the box they are installing.
nxeon_ssh_client_ip() {
  local ip; ip="$(awk '{print $1}' <<<"${SSH_CONNECTION:-}")"
  nxeon_valid_ipv4 "$ip" && echo "$ip" || true
}

# /etc/nxeon/admin-ips.nft content: nxeon_admin_ips_file <primary-ip> [other ips...]
nxeon_admin_ips_file() {
  local primary="$1"; shift
  echo "# Nxeon admin allowlist for this node — see admin-ip.sh --help."
  echo "# The PRIMARY's own IP is required: it is what this node's :8006 (Proxmox API) answers to"
  echo "# for every Proxmox operation the platform performs against this node."
  printf 'add element inet nxeon_fw nxeon_admin_v4 { %s } # primary node — added by onboard-node.sh\n' "$primary"
  local ip
  for ip in "$@"; do
    [[ "$ip" == "$primary" ]] && continue
    printf 'add element inet nxeon_fw nxeon_admin_v4 { %s } # operator — added by onboard-node.sh\n' "$ip"
  done
}

# /etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft content — the table is ALWAYS nxeon_fw (a past typo
# wrote nxeon_agent_fw and the whole ruleset failed `nft -c`).
nxeon_agent_allow_file() {
  printf 'add element inet nxeon_fw nxeon_agent_allow_v4 { %s } # primary node — added by onboard-node.sh\n' "$1"
}

# Insert `ignoreip = ...` under [sshd] of the repo's jail file so a few failed
# logins from the primary (e.g. before its key was installed) cannot ban the very
# host that administers this node. nxeon_jail_with_ignoreip <jail-file> <primary-ip>
nxeon_jail_with_ignoreip() {
  awk -v ip="$2" '{print} /^\[sshd\]/{print "ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 ::1 " ip}' "$1"
}

# Disable any ACTIVE Proxmox enterprise repo (needs a paid subscription; apt update
# 401s). Echoes the files it changed. nxeon_disable_enterprise_repos <apt-dir>
nxeon_disable_enterprise_repos() {
  local dir="$1" f changed=()
  for f in "$dir"/sources.list "$dir"/sources.list.d/*; do
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    case "$f" in
      *.sources)
        if grep -E '^URIs:' "$f" | grep -q 'enterprise.proxmox.com' && ! grep -qiE '^Enabled:[[:space:]]*(no|false)' "$f"; then
          printf '\nEnabled: no\n' >>"$f"; changed+=("$f")
        fi ;;
      *)
        if grep -E '^[[:space:]]*deb ' "$f" | grep -q enterprise.proxmox.com; then
          sed -i -E '/enterprise\.proxmox\.com/ s/^([[:space:]]*deb )/# \1/' "$f"; changed+=("$f")
        fi ;;
    esac
  done
  printf '%s\n' "${changed[@]}"
}

# Ensure pve-no-subscription exists somewhere. nxeon_ensure_no_subscription_repo <apt-dir> <codename>
nxeon_ensure_no_subscription_repo() {
  local dir="$1" codename="$2"
  if grep -rqs 'pve-no-subscription' "$dir/sources.list" "$dir/sources.list.d/" 2>/dev/null; then echo present; return 0; fi
  mkdir -p "$dir/sources.list.d"
  cat >"$dir/sources.list.d/proxmox-nxeon.sources" <<EOT
Types: deb
URIs: http://download.proxmox.com/debian/pve
Suites: ${codename}
Components: pve-no-subscription
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/proxmox-archive-keyring.gpg
EOT
  echo created
}

# Pool root of a PVE zfspool storage (first path component of its `pool` attr).
# nxeon_zpool_root_of_storage <storage.cfg> <storage-id>
nxeon_zpool_root_of_storage() {
  local pool; pool="$(nxeon_storage_attr "$1" "$2" pool)"
  [[ -n "$pool" ]] && echo "${pool%%/*}"
}

# Render the Add-node form block. All values passed as globals/args so it is testable.
# nxeon_render_form node_name pveNode apiUrl publicIp tokenId tokenSecret bridge subnetPrefix ipStart ipEnd sshStart sshEnd natChain nvme hdd capacityMB agentPort agentToken provider region
nxeon_render_form() {
  cat <<EOT
  Node name         : $1
  pveNode           : $2
  API URL           : $3
  Public IP         : $4
  Token ID          : $5
  Token secret      : $6
  Bridge            : $7
  Subnet prefix     : $8
  IP start / end    : $9 / ${10}
  SSH port range    : ${11} / ${12}
  NAT chain         : ${13}
  NVMe storage      : ${14}
  HDD storage       : ${15}
  Capacity RAM MB   : ${16}
  Agent port        : ${17}
  Agent token       : ${18}
  Provider          : ${19}
  Region            : ${20}
  Provider server ID: <OVH: hostname from GET /dedicated/server; Hetzner: numeric server number>
  Monthly cost cents: <what you pay the provider each month, e.g. 4200 = \$42.00>
  Enabled           : leave OFF until verify-node.sh is clean and the smoke test passed
EOT
}
EOF
bash -n node-canon.sh && echo ok

# nxeon_zpool_root_of_storage <storage.cfg> <storage-id>
nxeon_zpool_root_of_storage() {
  local pool; pool="$(nxeon_storage_attr "$1" "$2" pool)"
  [[ -n "$pool" ]] && echo "${pool%%/*}"
}

# Render the Add-node form block. All values passed as globals/args so it is testable.
# nxeon_render_form node_name pveNode apiUrl publicIp tokenId tokenSecret bridge subnetPrefix ipStart ipEnd sshStart sshEnd natChain nvme hdd capacityMB agentPort agentToken provider region
nxeon_render_form() {
  cat <<EOT
  Node name         : $1
  pveNode           : $2
  API URL           : $3
  Public IP         : $4
  Token ID          : $5
  Token secret      : $6
  Bridge            : $7
  Subnet prefix     : $8
  IP start / end    : $9 / ${10}
  SSH port range    : ${11} / ${12}
  NAT chain         : ${13}
  NVMe storage      : ${14}
  HDD storage       : ${15}
  Capacity RAM MB   : ${16}
  Agent port        : ${17}
  Agent token       : ${18}
  Provider          : ${19}
  Region            : ${20}
  Provider server ID: <OVH: hostname from GET /dedicated/server; Hetzner: numeric server number>
  Monthly cost cents: <what you pay the provider each month, e.g. 4200 = \$42.00>
  Enabled           : leave OFF until verify-node.sh is clean and the smoke test passed
EOT
}
EOF
bash -n node-canon.sh && echo ok
