#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# Nxeon — onboard a fresh Proxmox VE host as a compute node
# =============================================================================
# Run this ON the new Proxmox host (as root). It idempotently builds EVERYTHING a
# Nxeon compute node needs, ends by running scripts/verify-node.sh against itself,
# and prints the exact values to paste into the admin "Add node" form
# (/admin/nodes/new). Re-running is safe: every step checks current state first.
# The canonical definition of "a correct node" lives in scripts/node-canon.sh,
# shared with verify-node.sh so what this script builds and what the verifier
# checks cannot drift.
#
# Steps (each can be re-run alone; --skip-* flags preserved):
#    1. NAT bridge vmbrX on a per-node /24 (10.20.N.1/24), persisted in /etc/network/interfaces
#    2. ip_forward (persisted) + MASQUERADE (append-only, never flush)
#    3. Storages: vmdata (NVMe/ZFS), vmdata-hdd (backups+snippets; NEVER left on the
#       root fs — a same-pool ZFS dataset is carved if there is no spare disk), `backup` alias
#    4. Host tuning: ZFS ARC cap, journald cap, chrony, unattended-upgrades, smartmontools,
#       Proxmox repos (no-subscription), optional SSH hardening
#    5. Cloud-init vendor snippet (byte-identical to every other node)
#    6. Proxmox API role (the CANONICAL 27 privileges) + user + token + ACL
#    7. OS templates 9000-9009 (restored from a primary export; verified)
#    8. Host firewall (nftables + fail2ban): seeded with the primary AND the operator's own IP;
#       applied with --apply-firewall (safe-apply with auto-revert)
#    9. node-agent (Node.js, TLS cert, token, systemd unit)
#   10. Local disaster-recovery backups: scripts + timer ENABLED AND STARTED + first run
#   11. Self-verify (verify-node.sh local) + print the Add-node form values
#
# SAFETY:
#   - Never flushes the firewall. Never touches running VMs. Never destroys storage.
#   - `pvesm add` is skipped when the storage id exists. Template restores skip any VMID that exists.
#   - Carving the backup dataset on a node whose backup storage ALREADY exists on the root fs
#     moves data, so it only happens when you pass --carve-backup-dataset explicitly.
#
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CROSS-HOST NETWORKING — IMPORTANT LIMITATION
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Each node NATs its OWN private /24 (10.20.N.0/24) behind its OWN public IP. A VM on
# node-1 (10.20.0.x) CANNOT reach a VM on node-2 (10.20.1.x): separate NAT islands.
# The worker's NXEON_FWD* NAT chain is created and maintained per host from the DB (via
# the node-agent for non-primary nodes). Private east-west traffic would need a
# WireGuard/VXLAN overlay — out of scope, deliberate. Assumption: each node is a SEPARATE
# physical box with its own public IP.
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
REPO_DIR="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"

if [[ ! -f "${SCRIPT_DIR}/node-canon.sh" ]]; then
  echo "scripts/node-canon.sh must sit next to this script (it is the canonical node definition). Copy the whole kit." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# shellcheck source=scripts/node-canon.sh
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/node-canon.sh"

# ---------- Parameters (flags override env) ----------------------------------
NODE_NUM="${NODE_NUM:-}"            # REQUIRED: ordinal; drives subnet + nat chain
SUBNET_OCTET=""                     # third octet of 10.20.X.0/24 (default: NODE_NUM-1)
PUBLIC_IP="${PUBLIC_IP:-}"          # this host's public IPv4 (auto-detected if empty)
BRIDGE=""                           # vmbrX (default: vmbr1)
NVME_STORAGE="${NVME_STORAGE:-vmdata}"
HDD_STORAGE="${HDD_STORAGE:-vmdata-hdd}"
NVME_ZPOOL="${NVME_ZPOOL:-}"        # existing ZFS pool/dataset for NVMe storage (auto-detected if exactly one non-boot pool)
HDD_DIR="${HDD_DIR:-/tank/backup}"  # dir-backed HDD storage path
SNIPPETS_STORAGE="${SNIPPETS_STORAGE:-}"   # default: HDD_STORAGE
TOKEN_USER="${TOKEN_USER:-$NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_USER}"
TOKEN_NAME="${TOKEN_NAME:-$NXEON_CANON_TOKEN_NAME}"
TOKEN_ROLE="${TOKEN_ROLE:-$NXEON_CANON_ROLE}"
BUILD_TEMPLATES="${BUILD_TEMPLATES:-0}"   # 1 = build 9002-9004 here (NOT recommended; see --templates-dir)
TEMPLATES_DIR="${TEMPLATES_DIR:-}"        # dir holding vzdump-qemu-90NN-*.vma.zst from scripts/export-templates.sh
SSH_PORT_START="${SSH_PORT_START:-20000}"
SSH_PORT_END="${SSH_PORT_END:-29999}"
PRIMARY_IP="${PRIMARY_IP:-}"
AGENT_PORT="${AGENT_PORT:-8943}"
PROVIDER="${PROVIDER:-}"            # OVH | HETZNER (printed in the form; validated against --region)
REGION="${REGION:-}"                # sgp1 | bhs1 | fsn1 ... (see lib/node-regions.ts)
SKIP_FIREWALL="${SKIP_FIREWALL:-0}"
SKIP_AGENT="${SKIP_AGENT:-0}"
SKIP_BACKUPS="${SKIP_BACKUPS:-0}"
SKIP_TUNING="${SKIP_TUNING:-0}"
SKIP_TEMPLATES="${SKIP_TEMPLATES:-0}"
SKIP_VERIFY="${SKIP_VERIFY:-0}"
ARC_MAX_GB="${ARC_MAX_GB:-$NXEON_CANON_ARC_GB_DEFAULT}"
CARVE_BACKUP_DATASET="${CARVE_BACKUP_DATASET:-0}"
ALLOW_ROOT_BACKUPS="${ALLOW_ROOT_BACKUPS:-0}"
BACKUP_QUOTA_GB="${BACKUP_QUOTA_GB:-}"
APPLY_FIREWALL="${APPLY_FIREWALL:-0}"
AUTO_CONFIRM_FIREWALL="${AUTO_CONFIRM_FIREWALL:-0}"
HARDEN_SSH="${HARDEN_SSH:-0}"
FORCE_SNIPPET="${FORCE_SNIPPET:-0}"
PLAN_ONLY="${PLAN_ONLY:-0}"
EXTRA_ADMIN_IPS=()

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: $0 --node-num N --primary-ip IP [flags]
  --node-num N          REQUIRED. Node ordinal. Subnet 10.20.(N-1).0/24, NAT chain NXEON_FWD_N<N>.
                         Must be unique fleet-wide (check /admin/nodes). There is no default on purpose:
                         a wrong default collided subnets before.
  --primary-ip IP       The PRIMARY node's own public IP (needed for firewall + agent + fail2ban).
  --public-ip IP        This host's public IPv4 (auto-detected from vmbr0 if omitted).
  --provider OVH|HETZNER   Printed in the Add-node values; checked against --region.
  --region CODE         Provider datacenter code (sgp1, bhs1, fsn1, ...), see lib/node-regions.ts.
  --subnet-octet N      Override the third octet (default: node-num - 1).
  --bridge vmbrX        NAT bridge name (default vmbr1).
  --nvme-storage NAME   NVMe storage id (default vmdata).
  --nvme-zpool POOL     ZFS pool/dataset to back it. Auto-detected when exactly one non-boot pool exists.
  --hdd-storage NAME    HDD/backup storage id (default vmdata-hdd).
  --hdd-dir PATH        Directory for it (default /tank/backup).
  --carve-backup-dataset  If ${HDD_DIR:-the backup dir} is on the ROOT filesystem, create a same-pool ZFS
                         dataset <pool>/backup mounted there (moving existing files into it). Automatic for a
                         fresh node; REQUIRED explicitly to fix an existing node (data is moved).
  --backup-quota-gb N   Optional ZFS quota on that dataset (protects vmdata from backups).
  --allow-root-backups  Accept a backup dir on the root fs (NOT recommended; verify-node FAILs it).
  --templates-dir DIR   Restore templates 9000-9009 from vzdump archives made by scripts/export-templates.sh.
  --build-templates     Build 9002-9004 from upstream images (legacy; images will differ from the primary's).
  --agent-port N        node-agent port (default 8943; must match the Add-node form).
  --admin-ip IP         Extra address allowed to reach SSH/8006 (repeatable). The IP you are SSHing from is
                         added automatically.
  --apply-firewall      Apply the firewall through firewall-safe-apply.sh (auto-revert armed) and ask you to
                         confirm from a SECOND terminal. Without it the firewall is prepared but not applied.
  --auto-confirm-firewall  Confirm without the second-terminal prompt (only if you accept the lock-out risk).
  --harden-ssh          Disable SSH password auth (only if an authorized key exists).
  --arc-max-gb N        ZFS ARC cap in GB (default ${NXEON_CANON_ARC_GB_DEFAULT}).
  --force-snippet       Overwrite an existing vendor snippet with the canonical one.
  --skip-firewall | --skip-agent | --skip-backups | --skip-tuning | --skip-templates | --skip-verify
  --plan                Print the derived plan + detected hardware and exit (changes nothing).
  -h, --help

Kit prerequisite: copy the whole scripts/ dir (plus deploy/ and node-agent/) to a path that is NOT
/opt/nxeon/scripts itself, e.g. /root/nxeon-kit. Files needed: scripts/{onboard-node,verify-node,
node-canon,firewall-node.nft,admin-ip,firewall-safe-apply,firewall-reachability,backup-vms,
backup-pve-config}.sh|nft, deploy/{fail2ban-nxeon.jail.conf,nxeon-firewall.service,nxeon-node-agent.service,
nxeon-backup-vms.service,nxeon-backup-vms.timer}, node-agent/index.js. A missing file makes that step FAIL
loudly (it never silently skips unless you passed the matching --skip-*).
EOF
}

parse_args() {
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --node-num) NODE_NUM="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --subnet-octet) SUBNET_OCTET="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --public-ip) PUBLIC_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --bridge) BRIDGE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --nvme-storage) NVME_STORAGE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --hdd-storage) HDD_STORAGE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --nvme-zpool) NVME_ZPOOL="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --hdd-dir) HDD_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --carve-backup-dataset) CARVE_BACKUP_DATASET=1; shift ;;
      --backup-quota-gb) BACKUP_QUOTA_GB="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --allow-root-backups) ALLOW_ROOT_BACKUPS=1; shift ;;
      --templates-dir) TEMPLATES_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --build-templates) BUILD_TEMPLATES=1; shift ;;
      --primary-ip) PRIMARY_IP="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --agent-port) AGENT_PORT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --provider) PROVIDER="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --region) REGION="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --admin-ip) EXTRA_ADMIN_IPS+=("$2"); shift 2 ;;
      --apply-firewall) APPLY_FIREWALL=1; shift ;;
      --auto-confirm-firewall) AUTO_CONFIRM_FIREWALL=1; shift ;;
      --harden-ssh) HARDEN_SSH=1; shift ;;
      --skip-firewall) SKIP_FIREWALL=1; shift ;;
      --skip-agent) SKIP_AGENT=1; shift ;;
      --skip-backups) SKIP_BACKUPS=1; shift ;;
      --skip-tuning) SKIP_TUNING=1; shift ;;
      --skip-templates) SKIP_TEMPLATES=1; shift ;;
      --skip-verify) SKIP_VERIFY=1; shift ;;
      --force-snippet) FORCE_SNIPPET=1; shift ;;
      --arc-max-gb) ARC_MAX_GB="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --plan) PLAN_ONLY=1; shift ;;
      -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
      *) echo "Unknown flag: $1" >&2; usage; exit 1 ;;
    esac
  done
}

log()  { echo -e "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $*"; }
ok()   { echo -e "  \033[32m✓\033[0m $*"; }
warn() { echo -e "  \033[33m!\033[0m $*"; WARNINGS+=("$*"); }
die()  { echo -e "  \033[31m✗ $*\033[0m" >&2; exit 1; }
WARNINGS=()
require_cmd() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing required command: $1"; }

# Safe-in-regex/shell sanity for every operator-supplied value that reaches a command.
validate_inputs() {
  [[ -n "$NODE_NUM" ]] || die "--node-num is required (no default: a wrong guess collided subnets before). See /admin/nodes for the numbers in use."
  nxeon_derive_net "$NODE_NUM" "$SUBNET_OCTET" || exit 1
  [[ -n "$PRIMARY_IP" ]] || { [[ "$SKIP_FIREWALL" == 1 && "$SKIP_AGENT" == 1 ]] || die "--primary-ip is required (firewall, agent allowlist and fail2ban all key off it), or pass --skip-firewall AND --skip-agent."; }
  [[ -z "$PRIMARY_IP" ]] || nxeon_valid_ipv4 "$PRIMARY_IP" || die "--primary-ip '${PRIMARY_IP}' is not an IPv4 address"
  local ip
  for ip in "${EXTRA_ADMIN_IPS[@]:-}"; do [[ -z "$ip" ]] || nxeon_valid_ipv4_or_cidr "$ip" || die "--admin-ip '${ip}' is not an IPv4/CIDR"; done
  [[ "$AGENT_PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( AGENT_PORT >= 1024 && AGENT_PORT <= 65535 )) || die "--agent-port must be 1024-65535"
  [[ "$ARC_MAX_GB" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( ARC_MAX_GB >= 1 )) || die "--arc-max-gb must be a positive integer"
  [[ -z "$BACKUP_QUOTA_GB" || "$BACKUP_QUOTA_GB" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || die "--backup-quota-gb must be an integer"
  [[ "$BRIDGE" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9]{0,14}$ ]] || die "--bridge must look like vmbr1"
  [[ "$NVME_STORAGE" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ && "$HDD_STORAGE" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ ]] || die "storage ids may only contain [A-Za-z0-9_.-]"
  [[ "$HDD_DIR" =~ ^/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$ ]] || die "--hdd-dir must be an absolute path of [A-Za-z0-9_./-]"
  [[ -z "$NVME_ZPOOL" || "$NVME_ZPOOL" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$ ]] || die "--nvme-zpool contains unsafe characters"
  [[ -z "$TEMPLATES_DIR" || "$TEMPLATES_DIR" =~ ^/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$ ]] || die "--templates-dir must be an absolute safe path"
  if [[ -n "$PROVIDER" ]]; then
    PROVIDER="${PROVIDER^^}"
    [[ "$PROVIDER" == OVH || "$PROVIDER" == HETZNER ]] || die "--provider must be OVH or HETZNER"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$REGION" ]]; then
    [[ -n "$PROVIDER" ]] || die "--region needs --provider"
    nxeon_region_valid "$PROVIDER" "$REGION" || die "region '${REGION}' is not valid for ${PROVIDER} (see NODE_REGIONS in lib/node-regions.ts — add it there FIRST for a new datacenter)"
  fi
}

# ============================================================================
step_preflight() {
  log "[0/11] Preflight"
  [[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]] || die "run as root on the Proxmox host"
  for c in pvesm pveum iptables qm python3 ip awk; do require_cmd "$c"; done
  [[ -d /etc/pve/nodes ]] || die "this does not look like a Proxmox VE host (/etc/pve/nodes missing)"
  PVE_NODE="$(hostname)"
  [[ -z "$BRIDGE" ]] && BRIDGE="vmbr1"
  [[ -z "$SNIPPETS_STORAGE" ]] && SNIPPETS_STORAGE="$HDD_STORAGE"
  if [[ -z "$PUBLIC_IP" ]]; then
    PUBLIC_IP="$(ip -4 -o addr show vmbr0 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1 | head -1)"
    [[ -n "$PUBLIC_IP" ]] || PUBLIC_IP="$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"
  fi
  nxeon_valid_ipv4 "$PUBLIC_IP" || die "could not determine this host's public IPv4 (got '${PUBLIC_IP}'); pass --public-ip"
  [[ "$PUBLIC_IP" != 10.* && "$PUBLIC_IP" != 192.168.* ]] || warn "public IP ${PUBLIC_IP} is a private address — is vmbr0 the public bridge?"
  # A wrong-zone/wrong-box mistake is expensive; show the facts the operator must eyeball.
  ok "host ${PVE_NODE}  public ${PUBLIC_IP}  PVE $(pveversion | head -1 | sed 's/ (running.*//')  RAM $(awk '/MemTotal/{printf "%d GB", $2/1048576+0.5}' /proc/meminfo)"
  [[ "$(findmnt -no FSTYPE / 2>/dev/null)" == zfs ]] && ROOT_ON_ZFS=1 || ROOT_ON_ZFS=0
  command -v zpool >/dev/null 2>&1 && HAVE_ZFS=1 || HAVE_ZFS=0
  if [[ -n "$PRIMARY_IP" && "$PUBLIC_IP" == "$PRIMARY_IP" ]]; then die "--primary-ip equals this host's own IP — you are about to run the compute-node onboarding ON the primary"; fi
  if [[ -n "$PROVIDER" && -n "$REGION" ]] && command -v geoiplookup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    warn "verify the region against the provider console (zone/campus) BEFORE continuing: ${PROVIDER}/${REGION} for ${PUBLIC_IP}"
  fi
  [[ -n "$REGION" ]] || warn "no --region given: the Add-node form values will say <region>; pick it from the provider console, never guess (a wrong-zone box was ordered once)"
  # Two nodes may never share a subnet: refuse if the bridge exists with a different address.
  if ip link show "$BRIDGE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    local have; have="$(ip -4 -o addr show "$BRIDGE" | awk '{print $4}' | head -1)"
    [[ -z "$have" || "$have" == "${D_GATEWAY}/24" ]] || die "bridge ${BRIDGE} already exists with ${have}, but node ${NODE_NUM} must use ${D_GATEWAY}/24 — wrong --node-num?"
  fi
  # Hardware overview (read-only) so the backup-volume decision is made with eyes open
  lsblk -dno NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MODEL 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    disk: /' || true
  [[ "$HAVE_ZFS" == 1 ]] && zpool list -H -o name,size,alloc,health 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    zpool: /' || true
}

step_plan() {
  cat <<EOF

PLAN (nothing changed)
  node-${NODE_NUM}: pveNode=${PVE_NODE} public=${PUBLIC_IP} provider=${PROVIDER:-?} region=${REGION:-?}
  network : ${BRIDGE} ${D_GATEWAY}/24, subnet ${D_SUBNET_CIDR}, NAT chain ${D_NAT_CHAIN}
  storage : ${NVME_STORAGE} (zpool=${NVME_ZPOOL:-auto}), ${HDD_STORAGE} -> ${HDD_DIR}, snippets on ${SNIPPETS_STORAGE}
  backup dir on root fs? $([[ -d "$HDD_DIR" && "$(stat -c %d "$HDD_DIR")" == "$(stat -c %d /)" ]] && echo "YES (a ZFS dataset would be carved)" || echo no)
  ARC cap ${ARC_MAX_GB} GB; templates ${TEMPLATES_DIR:-<none given>}; firewall $([[ $SKIP_FIREWALL == 1 ]] && echo skipped || echo "prepared$([[ $APPLY_FIREWALL == 1 ]] && echo ' + applied')"); agent $([[ $SKIP_AGENT == 1 ]] && echo skipped || echo "port ${AGENT_PORT}")
  operator IP seeded into the admin allowlist: $(nxeon_ssh_client_ip || true)
EOF
}

# ============================================================================
step_bridge() {
  log "[1/11] NAT bridge ${BRIDGE} (${D_GATEWAY}/24)"
  local conf_has=0
  grep -rqsE "^[[:space:]]*auto[[:space:]]+${BRIDGE}\b" /etc/network/interfaces /etc/network/interfaces.d/ && conf_has=1
  if (( conf_has == 0 )); then
    cat >>/etc/network/interfaces <<EOF

# --- Nxeon node #${NODE_NUM} NAT bridge (added by onboard-node.sh) ---
auto ${BRIDGE}
iface ${BRIDGE} inet static
        address ${D_GATEWAY}/24
        bridge-ports none
        bridge-stp off
        bridge-fd 0
        post-up   echo 1 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward
        post-up   iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s ${D_SUBNET_CIDR} ! -d ${D_SUBNET_CIDR} -j MASQUERADE
        post-down iptables -t nat -D POSTROUTING -s ${D_SUBNET_CIDR} ! -d ${D_SUBNET_CIDR} -j MASQUERADE
EOF
    ok "wrote ${BRIDGE} stanza to /etc/network/interfaces (persisted)"
  else
    ok "${BRIDGE} stanza already in /etc/network/interfaces"
  fi
  if ip link show "$BRIDGE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ok "bridge ${BRIDGE} is up"
  else
    # bring up just this bridge; never reload every interface on a live host
    ifup "$BRIDGE" 2>/dev/null || warn "ifup ${BRIDGE} failed — it will come up on the next reboot, but run: ifup ${BRIDGE}"
    ip link show "$BRIDGE" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ok "bridge ${BRIDGE} is up"
  fi
}

step_forwarding() {
  log "[2/11] IPv4 forwarding + MASQUERADE (append-only, never flush)"
  sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 >/dev/null
  nxeon_sysctl_conf >/etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon.conf
  # the older onboard script wrote 99-nxeon-ipforward.conf; same key, drop the duplicate
  [[ -f /etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon-ipforward.conf ]] && rm -f /etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon-ipforward.conf
  ok "ip_forward=1 live and persisted (/etc/sysctl.d/99-nxeon.conf)"
  if iptables -t nat -C POSTROUTING -s "$D_SUBNET_CIDR" ! -d "$D_SUBNET_CIDR" -j MASQUERADE 2>/dev/null; then
    ok "MASQUERADE for ${D_SUBNET_CIDR} present"
  else
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s "$D_SUBNET_CIDR" ! -d "$D_SUBNET_CIDR" -j MASQUERADE
    ok "appended MASQUERADE for ${D_SUBNET_CIDR}"
  fi
  warn "NAT chain ${D_NAT_CHAIN} is created on the first provision by the worker/agent (empty nodes legitimately lack it)"
}

# ============================================================================
storage_exists() { pvesm status -storage "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || grep -qE "^[a-z]+:[[:space:]]+${1}\$" /etc/pve/storage.cfg; }

# Is <path> on the same filesystem as / ?
path_on_root_fs() { [[ -d "$1" ]] && [[ "$(stat -c %d "$1")" == "$(stat -c %d /)" ]]; }

# Carve <poolroot>/backup mounted at HDD_DIR, preserving anything already there.
carve_backup_dataset() {
  local poolroot="$1" ds="$1/backup" aside=""
  [[ "$HAVE_ZFS" == 1 ]] || die "cannot carve a backup dataset: ZFS tools not present"
  if zfs list -H -o name "$ds" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    local mp; mp="$(zfs get -H -o value mountpoint "$ds")"
    [[ "$mp" == "$HDD_DIR" ]] || die "dataset ${ds} exists but is mounted at ${mp}, not ${HDD_DIR} — resolve by hand"
    zfs mount "$ds" 2>/dev/null || true
    ok "dataset ${ds} already exists at ${HDD_DIR}"
  else
    if [[ -d "$HDD_DIR" && -n "$(ls -A "$HDD_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then
      aside="${HDD_DIR}.pre-zfs-$$"
      log "    moving existing ${HDD_DIR} contents aside to ${aside} (same filesystem: instant) so the dataset can mount"
      mv "$HDD_DIR" "$aside"
    fi
    zfs create -o mountpoint="$HDD_DIR" "$ds"
    ok "created ZFS dataset ${ds} mounted at ${HDD_DIR}"
    if [[ -n "$aside" ]]; then
      log "    restoring contents into the dataset (this copies across filesystems — can take a while)"
      cp -a "${aside}/." "${HDD_DIR}/" && rm -rf "$aside"
      ok "existing backup files moved onto ${ds}"
    fi
  fi
  [[ -z "$BACKUP_QUOTA_GB" ]] || { zfs set quota="${BACKUP_QUOTA_GB}G" "$ds"; ok "quota ${BACKUP_QUOTA_GB}G on ${ds}"; }
}

detect_nvme_pool() {
  # explicit flag wins; else the pool already behind the storage; else exactly one non-boot pool
  [[ -n "$NVME_ZPOOL" ]] && return 0
  if storage_exists "$NVME_STORAGE"; then NVME_ZPOOL="$(nxeon_storage_attr /etc/pve/storage.cfg "$NVME_STORAGE" pool)"; return 0; fi
  [[ "$HAVE_ZFS" == 1 ]] || return 0
  local pools; mapfile -t pools < <(zpool list -H -o name 2>/dev/null | grep -vx rpool)
  if (( ${#pools[@]} == 1 )); then NVME_ZPOOL="${pools[0]}"; ok "auto-detected the VM pool: ${NVME_ZPOOL}"
  elif (( ${#pools[@]} == 0 )) && zpool list -H -o name 2>/dev/null | grep -qx rpool; then
    NVME_ZPOOL="rpool/data"; ok "only the boot pool exists: using rpool/data for VM disks (as node-2 does)"
  else warn "several ZFS pools (${pools[*]:-none}) — pass --nvme-zpool <pool> explicitly"; fi
}

step_storages() {
  log "[3/11] Storages: ${NVME_STORAGE} + ${HDD_STORAGE} (+ backup alias)"
  detect_nvme_pool
  if storage_exists "$NVME_STORAGE"; then
    ok "storage ${NVME_STORAGE} already exists"
  elif [[ -n "$NVME_ZPOOL" ]]; then
    pvesm add zfspool "$NVME_STORAGE" --pool "$NVME_ZPOOL" --content images,rootdir --sparse 1
    ok "created zfspool storage ${NVME_STORAGE} on ${NVME_ZPOOL}"
  else
    die "storage ${NVME_STORAGE} missing and no ZFS pool could be chosen — create it: pvesm add zfspool ${NVME_STORAGE} --pool <pool> --content images,rootdir --sparse 1  (check zpool list first)"
  fi

  # --- backup / snippets volume: must NOT live on the root filesystem -----------------
  # Learned twice: node-3 (SYS-1, no 3rd disk) and node-5 (SYS-1, 20 GB root) both had
  # `vmdata-hdd` silently resolve to a directory on the 20 GB root partition; node-5's
  # root is 96% full of vzdump archives as of 2026-10-01.
  local poolroot=""
  [[ -n "$NVME_ZPOOL" ]] && poolroot="${NVME_ZPOOL%%/*}"
  [[ -z "$poolroot" ]] && poolroot="$(nxeon_zpool_root_of_storage /etc/pve/storage.cfg "$NVME_STORAGE")"
  if storage_exists "$HDD_STORAGE"; then
    local existing; existing="$(nxeon_storage_attr /etc/pve/storage.cfg "$HDD_STORAGE" path)"
    [[ -n "$existing" ]] && HDD_DIR="$existing"
    if path_on_root_fs "$HDD_DIR"; then
      if [[ "$CARVE_BACKUP_DATASET" == 1 && -n "$poolroot" ]]; then carve_backup_dataset "$poolroot"
      elif [[ "$ALLOW_ROOT_BACKUPS" == 1 ]]; then warn "backup storage ${HDD_STORAGE} (${HDD_DIR}) is on the root fs — accepted by --allow-root-backups"
      else
        warn "backup storage ${HDD_STORAGE} (${HDD_DIR}) is ON THE ROOT FILESYSTEM — it will fill / and take Proxmox down."
        warn "  Fix (moves existing backups onto a same-pool ZFS dataset): re-run with --carve-backup-dataset"
      fi
    else ok "storage ${HDD_STORAGE} already exists at ${HDD_DIR} (own filesystem)"; fi
  else
    if path_on_root_fs "$HDD_DIR" || [[ ! -d "$HDD_DIR" ]]; then
      # Not yet a mountpoint of its own. Is there a real spare disk? We cannot know; the
      # operator decides with --allow-root-backups; the default is the safe dataset.
      if [[ "$ALLOW_ROOT_BACKUPS" == 1 ]]; then mkdir -p "$HDD_DIR"; warn "${HDD_DIR} will live on the root fs (--allow-root-backups)"
      elif [[ -n "$poolroot" && "$HAVE_ZFS" == 1 ]]; then
        if findmnt -rn "$HDD_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! path_on_root_fs "$HDD_DIR"; then ok "${HDD_DIR} is already its own mount"
        else carve_backup_dataset "$poolroot"; fi
      else die "${HDD_DIR} would be on the root filesystem and no ZFS pool is available to carve a dataset from. Mount a real disk at ${HDD_DIR} first (or --allow-root-backups to accept the risk)."; fi
    fi
    mkdir -p "$HDD_DIR"
    pvesm add dir "$HDD_STORAGE" --path "$HDD_DIR" --content backup,iso,vztmpl,snippets
    ok "created dir storage ${HDD_STORAGE} at ${HDD_DIR}"
  fi
  mkdir -p "${HDD_DIR}/snippets" "${HDD_DIR}/dump" "${HDD_DIR}/platform"

  # `backup` alias — the primary's own storage is literally named "backup", and every template dumped
  # from it carries `cicustom: vendor=backup:snippets/...`. Without this alias vzdump/qmrestore of such a
  # template fails with "storage 'backup' does not exist" (hit on nodes 2, 3 and 4 before this existed).
  if [[ "$HDD_STORAGE" != backup ]] && ! storage_exists backup; then
    pvesm add dir backup --path "$HDD_DIR" --content snippets
    ok "created 'backup' storage alias (content=snippets) at ${HDD_DIR}"
  fi
  # snippets content must be enabled on the storage that holds them (apply, don't just warn)
  local cont; cont="$(nxeon_storage_attr /etc/pve/storage.cfg "$SNIPPETS_STORAGE" content)"
  if [[ ",${cont}," != *",snippets,"* ]]; then
    pvesm set "$SNIPPETS_STORAGE" --content "${cont:+${cont},}snippets"
    ok "enabled 'snippets' content on ${SNIPPETS_STORAGE}"
  fi
}

# ============================================================================
step_tuning() {
  log "[4/11] Host tuning (ZFS ARC cap, journald cap, time sync, updates, SMART, repos)"
  if [[ "$SKIP_TUNING" == 1 ]]; then warn "--skip-tuning given — ARC cap / journald / chrony / unattended-upgrades / SMART / repos NOT configured"; return 0; fi

  # --- ZFS ARC cap ---------------------------------------------------------------
  # Without it ZFS grows to ~50% of RAM and the admin RAM gauge reads CRITICAL on an empty node
  # (node-4 shipped without; node-2 sits at 0.4 GB which is the opposite mistake).
  if [[ "$HAVE_ZFS" == 1 ]]; then
    local arc_bytes=$((ARC_MAX_GB * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
    echo "options zfs zfs_arc_max=${arc_bytes}" >/etc/modprobe.d/zfs-arc.conf
    if [[ -w /sys/module/zfs/parameters/zfs_arc_max ]]; then
      echo "${arc_bytes}" >/sys/module/zfs/parameters/zfs_arc_max
      ok "ZFS ARC capped to ${ARC_MAX_GB} GB (live + /etc/modprobe.d/zfs-arc.conf)"
    else warn "ZFS module not loaded: ARC cap persisted for next boot only"; fi
    if [[ "$ROOT_ON_ZFS" == 1 ]]; then update-initramfs -u -k all >/dev/null 2>&1 && ok "initramfs rebuilt (root-on-ZFS needs the cap inside it)" || warn "update-initramfs failed — run: update-initramfs -u -k all"; fi
  fi

  # --- journald cap ------------------------------------------------------------------
  mkdir -p /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d
  printf '[Journal]\nSystemMaxUse=%s\n' "$NXEON_CANON_JOURNAL_MAX" >/etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/nxeon.conf
  systemctl restart systemd-journald && ok "journald capped at ${NXEON_CANON_JOURNAL_MAX}"

  # --- repos: disable enterprise (no subscription), ensure pve-no-subscription ----------
  local changed; changed="$(nxeon_disable_enterprise_repos /etc/apt | grep . || true)"
  [[ -n "$changed" ]] && ok "disabled enterprise repo(s): $(echo "$changed" | tr '\n' ' ')"
  local codename; codename="$(. /etc/os-release && echo "${VERSION_CODENAME:-trixie}")"
  [[ "$(nxeon_ensure_no_subscription_repo /etc/apt "$codename")" == created ]] && ok "added pve-no-subscription repo (${codename})" || ok "pve-no-subscription repo present"

  # --- packages ------------------------------------------------------------------
  local pkgs=() p
  for p in chrony unattended-upgrades smartmontools; do dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || pkgs+=("$p"); done
  if (( ${#pkgs[@]} > 0 )); then
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq || warn "apt-get update failed"
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq "${pkgs[@]}" && ok "installed: ${pkgs[*]}" || warn "apt install failed for: ${pkgs[*]} — install them manually"
  fi
  systemctl enable --now chrony >/dev/null 2>&1 || systemctl enable --now chronyd >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "could not start chrony"
  printf 'APT::Periodic::Update-Package-Lists "1";\nAPT::Periodic::Unattended-Upgrade "1";\n' >/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades
  systemctl enable --now unattended-upgrades >/dev/null 2>&1 && ok "unattended-upgrades enabled" || warn "could not enable unattended-upgrades"
  systemctl enable --now smartmontools >/dev/null 2>&1 || systemctl enable --now smartd >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "could not start smartmontools"
  ok "time sync / SMART monitoring enabled"

  # --- optional: disable SSH password auth (only when a key demonstrably exists) -----------
  if [[ "$HARDEN_SSH" == 1 ]]; then
    if [[ -s /root/.ssh/authorized_keys ]]; then
      printf 'PasswordAuthentication no\n' >/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-nxeon-hardening.conf
      if sshd -t; then systemctl reload ssh 2>/dev/null || systemctl reload sshd; ok "SSH password authentication disabled (key login still works)"
      else rm -f /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-nxeon-hardening.conf; warn "sshd -t failed; hardening reverted"; fi
    else warn "--harden-ssh skipped: /root/.ssh/authorized_keys is empty (you would lock yourself out)"; fi
  fi
}

# ============================================================================
step_snippet() {
  log "[5/11] Cloud-init vendor snippet"
  local snip; snip="$(pvesm path "${SNIPPETS_STORAGE}:snippets/nxeon-vendor.yaml" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ -n "$snip" ]] || snip="${HDD_DIR}/snippets/nxeon-vendor.yaml"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$snip")"
  local want have=""
  want="$(nxeon_vendor_snippet | sha256sum | cut -c1-12)"
  [[ -f "$snip" ]] && have="$(sha256sum "$snip" | cut -c1-12)"
  if [[ "$have" == "$want" ]]; then ok "vendor snippet already canonical (${snip})"
  elif [[ -f "$snip" && "$FORCE_SNIPPET" != 1 ]]; then warn "vendor snippet at ${snip} differs from the canonical one — kept (use --force-snippet to overwrite)"
  else nxeon_vendor_snippet >"$snip"; ok "wrote canonical vendor snippet to ${snip}"; fi
}

# ============================================================================
role_exists() { pveum role list --output-format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json, sys
try: roles = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception: sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0 if any(r.get('roleid') == '$1' for r in roles) else 1)"; }
user_exists() { pveum user list --output-format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json, sys
try: users = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception: sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0 if any(u.get('userid') == '$1' for u in users) else 1)"; }
token_exists() { pveum user token list "$1" --output-format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json, sys
try: tokens = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception: sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0 if any(t.get('tokenid') == '$2' for t in tokens) else 1)"; }

step_api() {
  log "[6/11] Proxmox API role/user/token (${TOKEN_USER}!${TOKEN_NAME}, role ${TOKEN_ROLE})"
  # Canonical privilege list lives in node-canon.sh (27 privileges, each documented there).
  # `pveum role modify --privs` REPLACES the list, so we always pass the full set: re-running
  # this step repairs a role that drifted (e.g. VM.GuestAgent.FileRead was missing fleet-wide).
  local privs; privs="$(nxeon_role_privs_csv)"
  if role_exists "$TOKEN_ROLE"; then pveum role modify "$TOKEN_ROLE" --privs "$privs"; ok "role ${TOKEN_ROLE} exists — privileges reset to the canonical ${#NXEON_CANON_ROLE_PRIVS[@]}"
  else pveum role add "$TOKEN_ROLE" --privs "$privs"; ok "created role ${TOKEN_ROLE} (${#NXEON_CANON_ROLE_PRIVS[@]} privileges)"; fi
  if user_exists "$TOKEN_USER"; then ok "user ${TOKEN_USER} exists"; else pveum user add "$TOKEN_USER"; ok "created user ${TOKEN_USER}"; fi
  pveum acl modify / --users "$TOKEN_USER" --roles "$TOKEN_ROLE" || die "could not grant ${TOKEN_ROLE} to ${TOKEN_USER} at /"
  ok "granted ${TOKEN_ROLE} to ${TOKEN_USER} at / (propagate)"
  TOKEN_SECRET=""
  if token_exists "$TOKEN_USER" "$TOKEN_NAME"; then
    warn "token ${TOKEN_USER}!${TOKEN_NAME} already exists — its secret was shown once at creation; reuse the saved one."
    warn "  (rotating it on a LIVE node breaks the platform until Node.tokenSecret is updated: ask the owner first)"
  else
    local out; out="$(pveum user token add "$TOKEN_USER" "$TOKEN_NAME" --privsep 0 --output-format json 2>/dev/null || true)"
    TOKEN_SECRET="$(printf '%s' "$out" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('value',''))" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [[ -n "$TOKEN_SECRET" ]] && ok "created token ${TOKEN_USER}!${TOKEN_NAME} (secret captured for the Add-node values)" \
      || warn "token creation failed/unparseable — run: pveum user token add ${TOKEN_USER} ${TOKEN_NAME} --privsep 0"
  fi
}

# ============================================================================
step_templates() {
  log "[7/11] OS templates (VMID 9000-9009)"
  if [[ "$SKIP_TEMPLATES" == 1 ]]; then warn "--skip-templates given — orders for any OS missing here FAIL at clone (scheduler does not check)"; return 0; fi
  local spec id name slug missing=() f archive
  for spec in "${NXEON_CANON_TEMPLATES[@]}"; do
    IFS='|' read -r id name slug <<<"$spec"
    [[ -r "/etc/pve/qemu-server/${id}.conf" ]] || missing+=("$id")
  done
  if (( ${#missing[@]} == 0 )); then ok "all 10 templates already present"
  elif [[ -n "$TEMPLATES_DIR" ]]; then
    [[ -d "$TEMPLATES_DIR" ]] || die "--templates-dir ${TEMPLATES_DIR} does not exist"
    if [[ -f "${TEMPLATES_DIR}/SHA256SUMS" ]]; then
      ( cd "$TEMPLATES_DIR" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --quiet ) || die "template archives failed their SHA256SUMS check — re-copy them"
      ok "template archives match SHA256SUMS"
    else warn "no SHA256SUMS in ${TEMPLATES_DIR} — archive integrity not checked"; fi
    for id in "${missing[@]}"; do
      archive="$(ls -t "${TEMPLATES_DIR}"/vzdump-qemu-"${id}"-*.vma.zst 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
      if [[ -z "$archive" ]]; then warn "no archive for template ${id} in ${TEMPLATES_DIR}"; continue; fi
      log "    restoring ${id} from $(basename "$archive")"
      qmrestore "$archive" "$id" --storage "$NVME_STORAGE" >/dev/null
      grep -q '^template: 1' "/etc/pve/qemu-server/${id}.conf" || qm template "$id" >/dev/null
      ok "template ${id} restored"
    done
  elif [[ "$BUILD_TEMPLATES" == 1 ]]; then
    warn "building 9002-9004 from upstream images (they will NOT be identical to the primary's; 9000/9001/9005-9009 are not built by this path)"
    if [[ -x "${SCRIPT_DIR}/build-templates.sh" ]]; then
      STORAGE="$NVME_STORAGE" VENDOR="${SNIPPETS_STORAGE}:snippets/nxeon-vendor.yaml" bash "${SCRIPT_DIR}/build-templates.sh" || warn "build-templates.sh returned non-zero"
    else warn "build-templates.sh not found next to this script"; fi
  else
    warn "missing templates: ${missing[*]} — NOT restored (no --templates-dir)."
    cat <<EOF
    On the PRIMARY:   scripts/export-templates.sh
                      rsync -avP /tank/backup/nxeon-templates-export/ root@${PUBLIC_IP}:${HDD_DIR}/nxeon-templates-import/
    Then re-run this script here with:  --templates-dir ${HDD_DIR}/nxeon-templates-import
    (The node's backup volume is used as the landing dir so a 20 GB root fs is never filled.)
EOF
  fi
  # a template's cicustom storage must exist on THIS node (restored-from-primary ones say `backup:` — the alias covers it)
  for spec in "${NXEON_CANON_TEMPLATES[@]}"; do
    IFS='|' read -r id name slug <<<"$spec"
    [[ -r "/etc/pve/qemu-server/${id}.conf" ]] || continue
    local cic; cic="$(sed '/^\[/,$d' "/etc/pve/qemu-server/${id}.conf" | sed -n 's/^cicustom: vendor=\([^:]*\):.*/\1/p')"
    if [[ -n "$cic" ]] && ! storage_exists "$cic"; then
      qm set "$id" --cicustom "vendor=${SNIPPETS_STORAGE}:snippets/nxeon-vendor.yaml" >/dev/null && ok "template ${id}: cicustom storage '${cic}' did not exist -> ${SNIPPETS_STORAGE}"
    fi
  done
}

# ============================================================================
step_firewall() {
  log "[8/11] Host firewall (nftables + fail2ban)"
  if [[ "$SKIP_FIREWALL" == 1 ]]; then warn "--skip-firewall given — this host has NO Nxeon firewall (SSH + Proxmox API open to the internet) until you do this step"; return 0; fi
  local f need=("${SCRIPT_DIR}/firewall-node.nft" "${SCRIPT_DIR}/admin-ip.sh" "${SCRIPT_DIR}/firewall-safe-apply.sh" "${SCRIPT_DIR}/firewall-reachability.sh" "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/fail2ban-nxeon.jail.conf" "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/nxeon-firewall.service")
  for f in "${need[@]}"; do [[ -f "$f" ]] || die "firewall kit file missing: $f (copy the whole kit, or pass --skip-firewall deliberately)"; done

  mkdir -p /etc/nxeon /opt/nxeon/scripts
  local operator; operator="$(nxeon_ssh_client_ip || true)"
  if [[ -n "$operator" && "$operator" != "$PRIMARY_IP" ]]; then ok "operator address ${operator} (your SSH source) will be allowlisted"
  else operator=""; warn "no distinct operator SSH IP detected (running from console / via the primary?). Pass --admin-ip <your-ip> or you cannot SSH in after the firewall is applied"; fi
  if [[ ! -f /etc/nxeon/admin-ips.nft ]]; then
    nxeon_admin_ips_file "$PRIMARY_IP" ${operator:+"$operator"} "${EXTRA_ADMIN_IPS[@]:-}" | grep -v '{ }' >/etc/nxeon/admin-ips.nft
    ok "wrote /etc/nxeon/admin-ips.nft (primary + operator)"
  else
    ok "/etc/nxeon/admin-ips.nft exists — kept; ensuring the primary is in it"
    grep -qF "$PRIMARY_IP" /etc/nxeon/admin-ips.nft || printf 'add element inet nxeon_fw nxeon_admin_v4 { %s } # primary node — added by onboard-node.sh\n' "$PRIMARY_IP" >>/etc/nxeon/admin-ips.nft
  fi
  if [[ ! -f /etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft ]]; then nxeon_agent_allow_file "$PRIMARY_IP" >/etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft; ok "wrote /etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft (primary only)"
  else grep -qF "$PRIMARY_IP" /etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft && ok "/etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft exists with the primary" || { nxeon_agent_allow_file "$PRIMARY_IP" >>/etc/nxeon/agent-allow.nft; ok "added the primary to agent-allow.nft"; }; fi
  # the table is nxeon_fw — this host's pre-firewall state is "no table", so rollback = delete it
  [[ -f /etc/nxeon/firewall.nft.rollback ]] || { { echo "table inet nxeon_fw"; echo "delete table inet nxeon_fw"; } >/etc/nxeon/firewall.nft.rollback; ok "wrote /etc/nxeon/firewall.nft.rollback"; }

  # scripts: always refresh (the old `cp -n` froze stale copies forever), guarding the same-file case
  local s src dst
  for s in admin-ip.sh firewall-safe-apply.sh firewall-reachability.sh; do
    src="${SCRIPT_DIR}/${s}"; dst="/opt/nxeon/scripts/${s}"
    [[ "$(readlink -f "$src")" == "$(readlink -f "$dst")" ]] && chmod 0755 "$dst" || install -m 0755 "$src" "$dst"
  done
  sed "s/define NXEON_AGENT_PORT = 8943/define NXEON_AGENT_PORT = ${AGENT_PORT}/" "${SCRIPT_DIR}/firewall-node.nft" >/opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft
  ok "installed /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft (agent port ${AGENT_PORT})"
  nft -c -f /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft || die "ruleset does NOT parse — fix /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall.nft or the two /etc/nxeon/*.nft files before applying"
  ok "ruleset parses (nft -c -f)"

  if command -v fail2ban-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok "fail2ban already installed"
  else DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq fail2ban >/dev/null && ok "installed fail2ban" || warn "fail2ban install failed — install it manually"; fi
  mkdir -p /etc/fail2ban/jail.d
  nxeon_jail_with_ignoreip "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/fail2ban-nxeon.jail.conf" "$PRIMARY_IP" >/etc/fail2ban/jail.d/nxeon.conf
  systemctl enable --now fail2ban >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "could not enable fail2ban"
  systemctl reload fail2ban 2>/dev/null || systemctl restart fail2ban 2>/dev/null || true
  ok "fail2ban sshd jail installed (primary ${PRIMARY_IP} in ignoreip)"

  cp "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/nxeon-firewall.service" /etc/systemd/system/nxeon-firewall.service
  systemctl daemon-reload
  systemctl enable nxeon-firewall.service >/dev/null 2>&1
  ok "nxeon-firewall.service installed + enabled (loads the ruleset at boot)"

  if [[ "$APPLY_FIREWALL" != 1 ]]; then
    warn "firewall prepared but NOT applied — apply it:  NXEON_FW_REQUIRED_PORTS=22 /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --check, then --apply, prove a 2nd connection, then --confirm (or re-run with --apply-firewall)"
    return 0
  fi
  export NXEON_FW_REQUIRED_PORTS=22
  /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --check || die "firewall preflight failed — not applying"
  /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --apply
  if [[ "$AUTO_CONFIRM_FIREWALL" == 1 ]]; then
    /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --confirm && ok "firewall applied and confirmed (--auto-confirm-firewall)"
  elif [[ -t 0 ]]; then
    echo "  >>> From a SECOND terminal: ssh root@${PUBLIC_IP} must still work, and https://${PUBLIC_IP}:8006 must load."
    local ans=""; read -r -t 280 -p "  >>> Type YES once a NEW connection worked (anything else/timeout = auto-revert in ~5 min): " ans || true
    if [[ "$ans" == YES ]]; then /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --confirm && ok "firewall applied and confirmed"; else warn "firewall NOT confirmed — it will auto-revert; re-run with --apply-firewall"; return 0; fi
  else
    warn "no tty to confirm on: the firewall was applied and WILL AUTO-REVERT unless you run /opt/nxeon/scripts/firewall-safe-apply.sh --confirm within ~5 minutes (from a second SSH session after proving it works)"
    return 0
  fi
  systemctl start nxeon-firewall.service 2>/dev/null && ok "nxeon-firewall.service state aligned (ActiveState=active)" || true
}

# ============================================================================
step_agent() {
  log "[9/11] Node-agent"
  AGENT_TOKEN_PRINT=""
  if [[ "$SKIP_AGENT" == 1 ]]; then warn "--skip-agent given — NAT sync + per-VM cloud-init snippets use the primary's degraded path for every server on this node"; return 0; fi
  [[ -f "${REPO_DIR}/node-agent/index.js" && -f "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/nxeon-node-agent.service" ]] || die "node-agent/index.js or deploy/nxeon-node-agent.service missing from the kit"
  if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok "Node.js already installed ($(node --version))"
  else
    warn "installing Node.js (NodeSource LTS) — the agent needs a JS runtime"
    curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x | bash - >/dev/null
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq nodejs
    ok "installed Node.js ($(node --version))"
  fi
  mkdir -p /opt/nxeon-agent /etc/nxeon
  cp "${REPO_DIR}/node-agent/index.js" /opt/nxeon-agent/index.js
  ok "copied node-agent to /opt/nxeon-agent/index.js"
  if [[ ! -f /etc/nxeon/node-agent.key.pem ]]; then
    openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 3650 -keyout /etc/nxeon/node-agent.key.pem -out /etc/nxeon/node-agent.cert.pem -subj "/CN=${PVE_NODE}-node-agent" >/dev/null 2>&1
    chmod 600 /etc/nxeon/node-agent.key.pem
    ok "generated a self-signed TLS cert (10 years)"
  else ok "TLS cert already present"; fi
  if [[ ! -f /etc/nxeon/node-agent.env ]]; then
    local tok; tok="$(openssl rand -base64 32 | tr -d '=+/\n' | head -c 43)"
    ( umask 077; {
      echo "NXEON_AGENT_PORT=${AGENT_PORT}"
      echo "NXEON_AGENT_TOKEN=${tok}"
      echo "NXEON_AGENT_TLS_KEY=/etc/nxeon/node-agent.key.pem"
      echo "NXEON_AGENT_TLS_CERT=/etc/nxeon/node-agent.cert.pem"
    } >/etc/nxeon/node-agent.env )
    chmod 600 /etc/nxeon/node-agent.env
    ok "generated a fresh agent token (/etc/nxeon/node-agent.env, 0600)"
  else
    chmod 600 /etc/nxeon/node-agent.env
    grep -q "^NXEON_AGENT_PORT=${AGENT_PORT}\$" /etc/nxeon/node-agent.env || { sed -i "s/^NXEON_AGENT_PORT=.*/NXEON_AGENT_PORT=${AGENT_PORT}/" /etc/nxeon/node-agent.env; ok "agent port in node-agent.env set to ${AGENT_PORT}"; }
    ok "/etc/nxeon/node-agent.env exists — reusing its token"
  fi
  AGENT_TOKEN_PRINT="$(grep '^NXEON_AGENT_TOKEN=' /etc/nxeon/node-agent.env | cut -d= -f2-)"
  cp "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/nxeon-node-agent.service" /etc/systemd/system/nxeon-node-agent.service
  systemctl daemon-reload
  systemctl enable nxeon-node-agent.service >/dev/null 2>&1
  systemctl restart nxeon-node-agent.service
  sleep 2
  systemctl is-active --quiet nxeon-node-agent.service && ok "nxeon-node-agent.service is running" || warn "nxeon-node-agent did not start — journalctl -u nxeon-node-agent -n 50"
}

# ============================================================================
step_backups() {
  log "[10/11] Local disaster-recovery backups"
  if [[ "$SKIP_BACKUPS" == 1 ]]; then warn "--skip-backups given — this node's guests have ZERO recovery path (local or off-site)"; return 0; fi
  local f need=("${SCRIPT_DIR}/backup-vms.sh" "${SCRIPT_DIR}/backup-pve-config.sh" "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/nxeon-backup-vms.service" "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/nxeon-backup-vms.timer")
  for f in "${need[@]}"; do [[ -f "$f" ]] || die "backup kit file missing: $f (or pass --skip-backups deliberately)"; done
  mkdir -p /opt/nxeon/scripts
  local s src dst
  for s in backup-vms.sh backup-pve-config.sh; do
    src="${SCRIPT_DIR}/${s}"; dst="/opt/nxeon/scripts/${s}"
    # `install` refuses to copy a file onto itself (aborts under set -e) — compare resolved paths first
    [[ "$(readlink -f "$src")" == "$(readlink -f "$dst")" ]] && chmod 0755 "$dst" || install -m 0755 "$src" "$dst"
  done
  cp "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/nxeon-backup-vms.service" "${REPO_DIR}/deploy/nxeon-backup-vms.timer" /etc/systemd/system/
  systemctl daemon-reload
  systemctl enable --now nxeon-backup-vms.timer
  # `enable` alone leaves the timer INACTIVE until reboot — node-2 sat 19 days with an enabled-but-dead timer.
  systemctl is-active --quiet nxeon-backup-vms.timer && ok "nxeon-backup-vms.timer enabled AND active (daily ~04:30)" || warn "timer is not active: systemctl start nxeon-backup-vms.timer"
  systemctl start --no-block nxeon-backup-vms.service
  ok "started a first backup run in the background (systemctl status nxeon-backup-vms)"
}

# ============================================================================
step_form() {
  log "[11/11] Add-node form values"
  API_URL="https://${PUBLIC_IP}:8006"
  local cap; cap="$(nxeon_capacity_ram_mb "$(awk '/MemTotal/{print int($2/1024)}' /proc/meminfo)")"
  local block
  block="$(nxeon_render_form "node-${NODE_NUM}" "$PVE_NODE" "$API_URL" "$PUBLIC_IP" "${TOKEN_USER}!${TOKEN_NAME}" \
    "${TOKEN_SECRET:-<shown ONCE at creation; reuse the value you saved>}" "$BRIDGE" "$D_SUBNET_PREFIX" 100 250 "$SSH_PORT_START" "$SSH_PORT_END" \
    "$D_NAT_CHAIN" "$NVME_STORAGE" "$HDD_STORAGE" "$cap" "$AGENT_PORT" \
    "${AGENT_TOKEN_PRINT:-<see /etc/nxeon/node-agent.env, or the agent step was skipped>}" "${PROVIDER:-<OVH|HETZNER>}" "${REGION:-<region code>}")"
  echo
  echo "  ┌── Nxeon \"Add node\" form values (Admin > Compute nodes > Add node) ──"
  echo "$block"
  echo "  └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────"
  local save="/root/nxeon-addnode-node-${NODE_NUM}.txt"
  ( umask 077; echo "$block" >"$save" )
  echo
  echo "  (also saved to ${save}, mode 0600 — it holds secrets: delete it once pasted)"
}

step_selfverify() {
  [[ "$SKIP_VERIFY" == 1 ]] && { warn "--skip-verify given — run scripts/verify-node.sh yourself"; return 0; }
  log "Self-verify (scripts/verify-node.sh local)"
  if [[ ! -f "${SCRIPT_DIR}/verify-node.sh" ]]; then warn "verify-node.sh not in the kit — cannot self-verify"; return 0; fi
  local args=(--no-db --node-num "$NODE_NUM" --agent-port "$AGENT_PORT")
  [[ -n "$PRIMARY_IP" ]] && args+=(--primary-ip "$PRIMARY_IP")
  VERIFY_RC=0
  bash "${SCRIPT_DIR}/verify-node.sh" "${args[@]}" --quiet local || VERIFY_RC=$?
}

step_epilogue() {
  cat <<EOF

NEXT (the owner's runbook, docs/DOCUMENTATION.md > "Adding node N"):
  1. Paste the values above into Admin > Compute nodes > Add node. Provider server ID + monthly cost are NOT
     discoverable from this box. OVH: the exact hostname from GET /dedicated/server (e.g. ns5013314.ip-15-235-145.net,
     NOT the numeric order id). Hetzner: the numeric server number from Robot. Leave blank rather than guess.
     Keep "enabled" OFF. Run the form's "Test node" (probes the Proxmox API + node-agent health).
  2. From the PRIMARY:   scripts/verify-node.sh node-${NODE_NUM}     (DB + reachability + drift checks; must be READY)
  3. Region/marketing wiring (new datacenter only), then a throwaway test server (VPS + a game), then enable.
  4. Cross-host private networking is NOT configured (NAT islands, see header).
EOF
  if (( ${#WARNINGS[@]} > 0 )); then
    echo; echo "WARNINGS raised during this run (${#WARNINGS[@]}):"; printf '  - %s\n' "${WARNINGS[@]}"
  fi
}

main() {
  parse_args "$@"
  if [[ "$PLAN_ONLY" != 1 || -n "$NODE_NUM" ]]; then validate_inputs; fi
  [[ -n "$NODE_NUM" ]] || { usage; exit 1; }
  step_preflight
  log "Onboarding node #${NODE_NUM} — ${PVE_NODE} (${PUBLIC_IP}); subnet ${D_SUBNET_CIDR} via ${BRIDGE}, NAT chain ${D_NAT_CHAIN}"
  if [[ "$PLAN_ONLY" == 1 ]]; then step_plan; exit 0; fi
  TOKEN_SECRET=""; AGENT_TOKEN_PRINT=""; VERIFY_RC=0
  step_bridge
  step_forwarding
  step_storages
  step_tuning
  step_snippet
  step_api
  step_templates
  step_firewall
  step_agent
  step_backups
  step_form
  step_selfverify
  step_epilogue
  log "Onboarding complete for node #${NODE_NUM} (${PVE_NODE}); self-verify exit ${VERIFY_RC}."
  exit "$VERIFY_RC"
}

# Sourceable for unit tests: NXEON_ONBOARD_SOURCE_ONLY=1 source scripts/onboard-node.sh
if [[ "${NXEON_ONBOARD_SOURCE_ONLY:-0}" != 1 ]]; then main "$@"; fi
